Location: Remote, must be located and authorized to work in the United States or Canada without current or future sponsorship

ABOUT GLOBUS FAMILY OF BRANDS

With 98+ years in travel, the award-winning Globus family of brands – consisting of Globus, Cosmos, and Avalon Waterways – creates vacations that offer travelers culture-rich experiences featuring must-see sights, the stories behind the scenes and countless joy-filled memories in more than 70 countries on six continents across the globe. With equal measures vision and hard work; team collaboration and commitment; adaptability, honesty, and integrity as well as a genuine love for all-things-travel, the Globus family of brands – a leader in international travel – now offers unparalleled, perfectly planned tours; inventive, inspiring cruises and modern, independent vacation packages to millions of travelers.

Travel and/or in-office presence may be required at times. Generous benefit package including travel benefits and retirement.

EXPERIENCE REQUIRED

The preferred candidate has noteworthy experience in the following areas:

  • 7–10+ years of delivery or program leadership within Agile, SAFe, or Hybrid organizations.
  • Proven experience leading cross-functional agile teams simultaneously, including PI level and program level coordination.
  • Deep understanding of SAFe, Scrum, and Kanban; familiarity with product funding and value stream mapping.
  • Experiencing operating alongside Program Managers and Product Owner roles in a mixed methodology environment (Agile, Hybrid and Waterfall running concurrently)
  • Strong business acumen with ability to connect technical work to customer outcomes.
  • Certifications: SAFe RTE or SPC, PMI-ACP, CSM, or equivalent.
  • Value-driven leadership — focuses on outcomes and benefits, not outputs
  • Servant leadership & empowerment — removes blockers and builds team ownership
  • Systems thinking — connects delivery flow to enterprise strategy
  • Transparency & trust-building — promotes open, data-informed decision making
  • Risk fluency – surfaces and escalates issues early rather than absorbing them silently

THE POSITION

The Agile Delivery Manager (ADM) is accountable for delivering business value across one or more agile teams, specifically in support of the organization’s digital transformation. Acting as a servant leader and connector between strategic intent and operational execution, the ADM sits at the bridge point between the product/feature layer (Product Owners, Business Analysts, Business Owners) and the delivery layer (Engineering Managers, Developers, QA, and the Scrum Masters who own team-level performance). The ADM ensures that delivery aligns with product roadmaps, value streams, and enterprise priorities.

This role is not about managing tasks—it’s about enabling flow, clarity, and measurable outcomes that advance the organization’s customer and business goals. The ADM owns the health and predictability of the Program Increment (PI): making sure it is planned well, tracked honestly, and delivered against — while escalating risks and dependencies before they become blockers. .

The role is responsible for the following results:

Delivery Flow and Value

  • Consistently leveraging lean and agile practices to achieve outcomes, not just complete output.
  • Orchestrate planning and coordination activities across multiple teams, including PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums and cross-team synchronization, and protecting the teams against interference and over commitment, to sustain focus and health velocity.
  • Advise Product Owners and Business Analysts in backlog management and sequencing to ensure clear cross-team prioritization.
  • Monitor flow and delivery health metrics (predictability, throughput, cycle time, PI objective achievement) and share them with teams to celebrate progress and surface improvement opportunities
  • Use performance and progress data to increase transparency and predictability in meeting commitments to the business.
  • Facilitate the adoption and evolution of agile practices to continuously improve how the organization produces high quality and high value outcomes.
  • Align teams with strategic goals through transparent sequencing of work, clear identification of cross-team dependencies; own the identification, tracking, and mitigation of delivery risks and issues, ensuring timely resolution or escalation.
  • Facilitate scaled/cross-team agile events (e.g., PI Planning, System Demo, Inspect & Adapt, Scrum of Scrums) so they are productive and time-boxed, setting a consistent standard of effectiveness across teams. Team-level ceremonies remain owned by Scrum Masters. Ensure delivery standards and definitions of done are applied consistently across the teams.

Enablement & Coaching

  • Coach Scrum Masters, Business Owners, Product Owners and Business Analysts to communicated in terms of value delivered rather than requirement fulfillment.
  • Guide continuous improvement through retrospectives, delivery health checks, and root-cause analysis at the multi-team and PI Levels
  • Build agile maturity through mentoring, modeling psychological safety, and reenforcing learning cycles.

Stakeholder Engagement

  • Translate delivery progress into business impact, reporting what value was realized, not just completed.
  • Own upward and outward communication of delivery status, risks, and PI outcomes to executives, business owners, the Governance & Transformation Lead, and technology leadership.
  • Ensure the “voice of delivery” is represented in strategic planning and portfolio discussions.

SUCCESS METRICS

  • PI predictability (planned vs. delivered PI objectives) across teams in scope.
  • Flow metrics trend (cycle time, throughput, work-in-progress) shared and improving over time.
  • Time-to-resolution on escalated risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.
  • Stakeholder-reported clarity and trust in delivery commitments (Business Owners, executive sponsors).
  • Team-reported psychological safety and agile maturity progression.

THE DEPARTMENT

Enterprise Value Delivery is responsible for developing and implementing strategic initiatives to address various operational challenges and optimize business performance.  Its primary objective is to identify, analyze and provide practical solutions to enhance productivity, efficiency, and profitability for the company.   The Enterprise Value Delivery office utilizes a combination of analytical tools, industry best practices, and cross-functional collaboration to identify opportunities for improvement, streamline processes, implement technology solutions, and drive innovation.

EDUCATION

The preferred candidate will hold a Bachelor’s degree in a related field i.e. Business or Project Management; or five to seven years’ related experience and/or training; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

EOE

While performing this job, it will require: Eight (8) hours or more a day of sitting; walking; standing; bending; answering the telephone; entering data into the computer; retrieving data from the computer or analyzing data from reports.

We are more than a health system. We are a belief system. We believe wellness and sickness are both part of a lifelong partnership, and that everyone could use an expert guide. We work hard, care deeply and reach further to help people uncover their own power to be healthy. We inspire hope. We learn, grow, and achieve more – in our careers and in our communities.

Job Description Summary:

The Systems Analyst Epic supports the design, build, testing, training, deployment, and ongoing support of Epic applications to optimize clinical and operational workflows. This position develops knowledge of healthcare workflows, system integration, and project delivery practices while partnering with operational leaders and end users to translate business requirements into reliable Epic configuration, integrations, and reporting—supporting safe patient care, efficient revenue cycle operations, and regulatory compliance while meeting Service Level Agreements (SLAs) for supported applications. Works under guidance of senior analysts, architects, and technical leads to follow standards that safeguard the integrity and security of the application environment and contribute to continuous improvement activities related to application management for Epic and related third-party applications. The System Analyst Epic encompasses two closely related role focus areas: Application Build and Application Training. While responsibilities are similar, emphasis may vary based on team assignments.

Responsibilities And Duties:

Both Roles

System Analysis and Design:

Engage stakeholders to gather and refine requirements, map current-state workflows, and design Epic build that aligns with operational goals and policy.
Create and maintain specifications, decision logs, and design documents for clear traceability and change control.
Conduct gap analyses to identify configuration or workflow changes needed for upgrades, regulatory changes, or new initiatives.

Project Management:
Support small projects and enhancements related to system implementations and upgrades under the guidance of senior team members.
Working knowledge of common project approaches (e.g., waterfall, agile) and ability to follow the established methodology.
Participate on project teams and apply agreed project methodology to deliver assigned tasks on time.

Training and Documentation:
Create and maintain documentation for system configurations, workflows, and support procedures, following team standards.

Application Build Role
Application Build, Configuration, and Deployment:
Configure records, master files, and tools (e.g., profiles, rules, security classes, workflows) aligned to approved design.
Maintain environment parity and adhere to change management and build naming conventions.
Develop and execute unit, integrated, and UAT test plans; log and resolve defects; document test evidence.
Validate interfaces, printing, reporting, and downstream workflows; confirm regression coverage in upgrades.
Coordinate release management, environment moves, and downtime procedures for upgrades and patches.
Provide go-live and post-live hypercare, including rounding, office hours, tip sheets, and at-the-elbow support.
Manage service requests and incidents in a timely manner; meet SLAs through effective triage, documentation, and root-cause analysis with guidance as needed.
Provide support for Epic and other enterprise applications as assigned. Collaborate with IT and operational teams to understand cross-application impacts and support integrated workflows (e.g., Epic and third-party applications).

Integration and Data Management:
Collaborate with interface teams on HL7, FHIR, PDFs, CCD/CCDA, and other exchange workflows.
Partner with analytics teams on Clarity/Caboodle extracts, registries, and operational reporting needs.
Ensure data integrity and metric definitions are consistent across modules and stakeholders. Compliance & Risk:
Support regulatory readiness (e.g., CMS, Joint Commission), audit needs, and policy alignment.
Embed privacy/security controls, including sensitive record handling and audit trails.
Contribute to ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and configuration management processes.

Application Training Role
Curriculum Management:
Support the design and delivery of role-based training aligned with operational workflows and organizational standards
Support maintenance and updates to the CareConnect curriculum in partnership with training leadership
Help ensure curriculum accuracy and consistency by following established build and validation processes
Incorporate learner and stakeholder feedback into curriculum updates and continuous improvement efforts
Support build, maintenance, and readiness activities for training environments under established standards
Communicate system releases and upgrade impacts to training stakeholders using approved channels and templates

Request/Incident Management
Manage end‑user training‑related requests and incidents with professionalism and efficiency
Support triage and resolution of requests within established service expectations, escalating as appropriate
Document incidents and resolutions to support a comprehensive knowledge base
Collaborate with IT and operational partners to identify trends and recommend preventative improvements
Contribute to support process improvements to enhance service quality and user experience

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor's Degree

Additional Job Description:

  • degree in computer science, Information Technology, Healthcare Administration, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 1-3 years of experience in system/application analysis, support, or related IT experience (healthcare environment preferred).
  • In lieu of degree, 5+ years of experience in system/application analysis, support, or related IT experience (healthcare environment preferred).

SPECIALIZED KNOWLEDGE

Required for Both Roles:

• Experience with Epic application(s) and healthcare workflows (clinical, revenue cycle or IT experience).

• Strong requirements gathering, workflow design, and testing skills.

• Familiarity with ITIL, change control, SDLC practices, system governance, and waterfall/agile project methodologies.

  • Ability to communicate with clinical, operational stakeholders, and managed service providers and produce clear documentation.

• Demonstrated ability to support small to medium initiatives and collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.

Requirements for Application Training role:

  • Epic Training Environment Build certification/proficiency (or ability to obtain within required timeframe) and 1+ year of training environment build or application support experience.
  • Epic Principal Trainer certification(s) preferred (or ability to obtain within the required timeframe).

Preferred for Application Build role:

Current Epic Certification or Proficiency in one or more relevant module(s) (e.g., HB, PB, Cadence, Referrals, Orders, ClinDoc, Clarity).

• 1+ year of Epic build/configuration experience preferred (or demonstrated ability to learn and apply build standards quickly).

• Exposure to system integration concepts (e.g., HL7, FHIR) and interface testing is preferred.

• Exposure to reporting and data concepts (e.g., Clarity/Caboodle, SlicerDicer, Reporting Workbench, Radar) is preferred.

• Prior work in patient access, billing, coding, finance, or clinical operations (for respective modules).

DESIRED ATTRIBUTES

  • ITIL Foundation certification desired not required.
  • Certifications in one or more Epic applications
  • Experience in a large healthcare system or hospital setting.
  • Experience with other healthcare applications and systems.
  • Knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance standards.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure).
  • Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools.

raw.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Director of Developer Experience, you will be tasked with leading the organization responsible for how every engineer at the company builds, tests, ships, and operates software. You will own two interconnected functions: Infrastructure Services (CI/CD orchestration, GitOps continuous delivery, artifact management, and related platforms) and Developer Tooling (the teams that design and operate our CI/CD pipelines and internal developer platform). Critically, you will also define and execute our strategy for integrating AI across the software development lifecycle, from AI-assisted code generation and review to AI-driven engineering intelligence platforms.

Developer experience is one of the highest-leverage investments an engineering organization can make, and AI is the largest shift in how software is built in a generation. The Director of Developer Experience will directly shape how hundreds of engineers spend their day, how quickly we ship, how confidently we operate in production, and how effectively we harness AI across the SDLC. This is a critically important role with executive visibility and a clear mandate to deliver measurable results.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Lead, grow, and develop a multi-team organization of managers and senior engineers spanning Infrastructure Services and Developer Tooling.
  • Define and execute the vision for developer experience, including build, test, deployment, artifact management, internal platform capabilities, and AI-augmented developer workflows.
  • Own the strategy and rollout of AI tooling across the SDLC, including AI coding assistants, AI code review and PR automation, AI-assisted test generation, and AI engineering intelligence platforms. Drive adoption, measure impact, and ensure these tools are deployed safely and effectively.
  • Ensure the availability, performance, and security of the systems that engineers depend on every day.
  • Drive the evolution of CI/CD pipelines to be faster, more reliable, more self-service, and more secure, including embedding AI capabilities such as automated triage, intelligent test selection, and AI-assisted incident response.
  • Establish metrics and use them to drive measurable improvement in developer productivity.
  • Partner with security, legal, and AI leadership to set policy for AI-generated code, IP and licensing, data handling, model selection, and acceptable-use guardrails.
  • Partner with security, SRE, product engineering, architecture, and AI/ML teams to align on standards, golden paths, and shared platforms.
  • Own the budget, tooling investments, and vendor relationships for the developer experience portfolio, including AI tooling spend.
  • Recruit, mentor, and retain exceptional engineering leaders and individual contributors.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 10+ years of progressive engineering experience, including 5+ years of engineering management and at least 2+ years leading managers (managing managers).
  • Demonstrated track record in building and scaling developer experience, platform engineering, or DevOps organizations in a mid-to-large engineering org.
  • Deep, hands-on familiarity with the modern CI/CD and developer tooling stack: Jenkins, ArgoCD, Artifactory or equivalents.
  • Practical experience evaluating, rolling out, and measuring the impact of AI developer tooling.
  • A clear point of view on how AI changes the SDLC and how to capture that value without compromising on security, code quality, or developer trust.
  • Strong understanding of Kubernetes, GitOps, containerization, and cloud-native deployment patterns.
  • Experience in defining and operating internal developer platforms and golden paths.
  • Excellent strategic thinking paired with a willingness to go deep on technical decisions when needed.
  • Strong communication and executive presence; able to influence across engineering and partner with security, compliance, legal, and product leadership.
  • A demonstrated bias toward developer empathy, self-service, and reducing toil.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

raw.description:
Who We Are

HIKE2 is an advisory and innovation partner helping organizations design and build what’s next.

We work with complex and regulated industries, including law firms, financial services, insurance, professional services, and high-growth SaaS companies, to modernize operating models and embed data, automation, and AI into the core of how work gets done.

Our clients aren’t just upgrading technology. They are rethinking workflows, activating governed AI, and designing environments where humans and intelligent systems work side by side.

We believe meaningful transformation happens when strategy, data, design, and engineering move together. Siloed initiatives don’t scale. Real progress requires clarity of vision, strong data foundations, responsible governance, and disciplined execution.

Our teams bring deep industry expertise, human-centered design, and advanced data and cloud capabilities to architect secure, scalable solutions built for real-world complexity. From modern data platforms to AI-enabled workflows and enterprise automation, we help organizations move from experimentation to measurable impact.

We thrive in change and move from blank slate to working systems. We care deeply about outcomes, trust, and building long-term partnerships.

We don’t just implement technology. We help design the future of work.

The Role

The Technical Project Manager – Data & Databricks is responsible for driving the day-to-day execution of complex data and Databricks engagements. This is a hands-on project leadership role for someone who combines strong project management discipline with deep experience delivering data, analytics, cloud, or data platform initiatives.

This person does more than manage a project plan. They understand the technical work being performed, can follow the details of architecture and engineering conversations, recognize dependencies and delivery risks, and ensure the team is following HIKE2’s technical and project delivery playbooks.

The Technical Project Manager reports into the PMO and partners closely with Databricks architects, data engineers, technical leads, consultants, and client stakeholders.

What You'll Do

  • Own the day-to-day execution and operating rhythm of assigned Databricks and data projects.

  • Own the connection between technical delivery, client priorities, and the business outcomes the platform is intended to enable.

  • Maintain the Jira board as the source of truth for project execution, including backlog, stories, tasks, dependencies, blockers, owners, and status.

  • Ensure work is appropriately defined, prioritized, assigned, estimated, and progressing through the delivery lifecycle.

  • Run project ceremonies including stand-ups, planning, backlog reviews, status meetings, and retrospectives as appropriate.

  • Produce and distribute the Weekly Pulse Report, clearly communicating progress, accomplishments, upcoming work, risks, decisions, dependencies, budget/burn, and items requiring attention.

  • Maintain project plans, milestones, RAID logs, decisions, action items, resource plans, and other required PMO artifacts.

  • Understand the technical delivery plan and ensure the team is following the established Databricks/data technical playbook.

  • Track technical dependencies across data sources, environments, pipelines, integrations, architecture, security, testing, deployment, and client teams.

  • Identify delivery risks early and drive issues to resolution rather than simply reporting status.

  • Ensure client and HIKE2 stakeholders have clear visibility into project health, decisions, risks, and next steps.

  • Partner with technical leads to translate technical work into an executable project plan and clear client communication.

  • Escalate issues through the PMO and delivery leadership when additional support or decisions are required

Requirements

  • 5+ years of project or program management experience, with significant experience leading data, analytics, cloud, or data platform implementations.

  • Demonstrated experience managing technical engineering teams and complex technical workstreams.

  • Demonstrated ability and willingness to continuously deepen technical knowledge across Databricks, modern data architecture, cloud platforms, analytics, and emerging AI/ML capabilities."

  • Strong working knowledge of Jira and Agile delivery practices.

  • Experience with Databricks strongly preferred; experience with comparable modern cloud data platforms may be considered.

  • Ability to understand technical architecture, engineering terminology, dependencies, and delivery sequencing.

  • Ability to translate those complex technical concepts into business terms for non-technical audiences

  • Strong client-facing communication and executive-level status reporting skills.

  • Comfortable operating in fast-moving projects where requirements, technical decisions, and priorities evolve.

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to move between detailed project execution and broader project health.

This role requires meaningful experience with data and technical delivery. The Technical PM does not need to be the project's architect or lead engineer, but they must be technically fluent enough to understand what the team is building and how the pieces fit together.

They should be comfortable discussing and managing work involving:

  • Databricks and modern data platforms, including how they support analytics, AI/ML, and GenAI workloads

  • Data engineering and data pipelines

  • ETL/ELT and data integration

  • Data architecture and modeling

  • Cloud data environments

  • Source-to-target mapping and data migration

  • Development, testing, deployment, and environment management

  • Data quality, governance, security, and access

  • Technical dependencies and integration points

  • Agile technical delivery and engineering backlogs

The expectation is that this person can sit in a technical working session, understand what is being discussed, capture the implications for the project, ask intelligent questions, and translate the conversation into actions, risks, dependencies, and Jira work.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Our team and our clients are able to effectively communicate with their teams about the value of the work and the timing of the deliverables.

  • Jira accurately reflects the work being performed and provides a reliable view of project status.

  • Weekly Pulse Reports are timely, concise, accurate, and give leadership and the client a clear picture of business outcomes and project health.

  • Technical and business dependencies are identified before they become delivery problems.

  • Risks and blockers are actively managed and escalated early.

  • Project milestones, commitments, and deliverables are consistently met.

  • The technical team can focus on delivery because the project is well organized and decisions, actions, and dependencies are actively managed.

  • Clients experience strong communication, transparency, and confidence in how the project is being led.

  • Projects consistently follow HIKE2 PMO standards and the applicable Databricks/data delivery playbook.

The salary range for this position is: $120,000-$180,000+k/annually. Actual compensation within the range will be dependent upon the individual's skills, experience, qualifications and location, and applicable employment laws. This range is exclusive of any bonuses or commissions. HIKE2 offers a wide range of benefits for full time employees which may include medical, dental, vision, 401k, holiday pay, vacation, personal and family sick leave, and more.

Don’t meet every requirement? As an innovation consultancy, we recognize that talent is not always related to job history and skills come from valuable experiences that aren’t always shown on a resume. If you are excited to make a positive impact, but your experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. CPG or QSR Advertising Research Expert-in-Residence
Zappi is looking for a senior advertising effectiveness and creative development expert to help strengthen our authority, differentiation, and commercial success in the advertising research and creative effectiveness space.

This person will serve as both:
  • A trusted expert, educator, and industry advocate externally
  • A strategic, cross-functional SME and connective layer internally
The role is designed for someone who has helped major brands understand how advertising works, diagnose creative opportunities, improve campaign performance, and translate consumer insight into stronger creative decisions. They should be credible with senior Insights, Marketing, Brand, Media, Creative, Commercial, and Strategy leaders, and able to connect methodological rigor with a modern, scalable approach to advertising research.

What you'll do:

Serve as an industry expert

  • Bring deep expertise in advertising strategy, creative effectiveness, campaign development, ad testing, and consumer research methodologies.
  • Act as a senior subject matter expert on creative testing, campaign diagnostics, norms, benchmarks, competitive dynamics, and market trends.
  • Understand how large enterprise organizations operate, including process, politics, agency dynamics, decision-making, budget pressures, stakeholder complexity, and media and creative timelines.
  • Stay ahead of emerging trends in advertising effectiveness, AI-generated creative, synthetic respondents, creative volume, digital and social testing, predictive models, and connected learning systems.
  • Function as a trusted internal advisor across the organization.

Help drive cross-functional GTM readiness

  • Work closely with Sales, Customer, Product, Product Marketing, Marketing, and Research Science teams on strategic narratives and customer engagements.
  • Help Product Marketing build messaging, frameworks, demos, POVs, enablement, competitive guidance, and customer-facing materials when expertise-level knowledge is needed.
  • Support enterprise opportunities as a strategic expert and advisor, speaking directly to customers and prospects when senior advertising expertise is needed.
  • Clarify where Zappi’s advertising solutions fit across the creative development lifecycle, from early creative exploration to validation, optimization, and connected learning.
  • Own the competitive intelligence program for advertising research and creative effectiveness, translating market, competitor, customer, and industry shifts into internal guidance and external-facing content.

Build external credibility

  • Develop a visible external voice in the advertising effectiveness and creative development space.
  • Create thought leadership on the future of advertising research, better creative decision-making at scale, AI in creative development, synthetic methods in ad testing, and connected creative learning.
  • Speak at conferences, webinars, customer events, and industry forums.
  • Engage with analysts, strategic customers, and industry communities.
  • Co-create customer education materials and programs with Customer Marketing.

Influence product and strategy

  • Translate customer realities, workflow needs, agency dynamics, and competitive gaps into actionable product and GTM recommendations.
  • Partner closely with Product, Research Science, and Commercialization teams.
  • Align with Product Marketing, Product, and Commercialization to pressure test emerging AI, synthetic, predictive, diagnostic, and connected-learning capabilities from both methodological and commercial perspectives.
  • Serve as a second voice outside of Product to help ensure product direction aligns with real-world customer workflows, buyer expectations, and unmet needs.
What success looks like
  • Zappi has a stronger, clearer, and more differentiated point of view in advertising effectiveness, creative development, and modern creative decisioning.
  • GTM teams are more confident and effective in advertising conversations, with stronger discovery, sharper positioning, and better objection handling.
  • Zappi’s advertising offerings are easier for Sales and Account teams to position as a strategic growth opportunity, not simply a set of point solutions or individual ad tests.
  • Enterprise buyers increasingly view Zappi as a strategic partner for advertising effectiveness, creative development, and connected campaign learning.
  • Product and GTM strategy are more closely aligned to customer realities, creative development workflows, competitive dynamics, and emerging market needs.
  • Zappi builds greater external authority through thought leadership, customer education, industry participation, and expert-led advertising narratives.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in creative development, ad testing, campaign strategy, consumer insights, advertising effectiveness, or market research.
  • Deep expertise in advertising research methodologies, including pre-market ad testing, creative diagnostics, campaign learning, norms, benchmarking, and KPI interpretation.
  • Experience working with enterprise brands and senior stakeholders across Insights, Marketing, Brand, Media, Creative, Commercial, or Strategy teams.
  • Strong understanding of how enterprise teams make advertising decisions, manage creative risk, and connect consumer insight to campaign performance.
  • Ability to translate complex advertising methodologies into clear commercial narratives, sales guidance, executive-level storytelling, and customer-facing POVs.
  • Experience supporting strategic sales, enterprise customer conversations, thought leadership, or consultative growth motions.
  • Exceptional communication, presentation, and storytelling skills, with comfort representing a company externally as a senior industry expert.
You may come from:
  • Consumer insights, brand, media, creative, or strategy teams
  • Advertising research, market research, or creative effectiveness consulting
  • Advertising effectiveness or creative development leadership
  • Senior roles within research, insights, ad tech, creative analytics, or marketing technology providers.

Why join us:

  • Three company-paid mental health days of rest per year (these are pre-scheduled, so the entire company can take the same days off regularly to reset)
  • Generous PTO policy - Minimum of 20 days of paid time off per year, plus national holidays. Leave over 30 days requires manager and People team approval.
  • Private medical healthcare cover

  • Flexible working arrangements, including remote (unless otherwise specified)

Why join us?
We’ve been recognized as one of the hottest martech companies in 2022 by Business Insider and named Best Place to Work by Quirk’s Media for our engaging and inclusive workplace culture. We’re committed to both people and the planet.
Our belief in inclusion means we’re building an organisation of diverse individuals and helping brands eliminate cultural presumptions in their research. Read our Diversity Manifesto here.
We are a values and behaviours driven business and believe that Trust, Truth, Ownership, Ambition and Humility describe Zappi employees on our best day. This is how we strive to show up for our customers, for each other and for our communities.

Earning B Corp certification assures us we’re on the right track and have structures in place to become the business we want to be.

Career-defining. Life-changing.

At iRhythm, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your skills and your career while impacting the lives of people around the world. iRhythm is shaping a future where everyone, everywhere can access the best possible cardiac health solutions. Every day, we collaborate, create, and constantly reimagine what’s possible. We think big and move fast, driven by our commitment to put patients first and improve lives. We need builders like you. Curious and innovative problem solvers looking for the chance to meaningfully shape the future of cardiac health, our company, and your career

About This Role:

Sr. Product Manager, Digital Platform – Clinician Workflow

iRhythm is looking for a Sr. Product Manager to join the digital platform product team. This role will focus on clinican-facing web portals, helping define, prioritize, and deliver workflow capabilities that support clinician-facing experiences, operational efficiency, and scalable platform growth. Over time, the role is expected to expand into broader digital platform responsibilities across clinician workflow, integrations, and adjacent platform capabilities that support iRhythm’s evolving product portfolio. You will partner closely with engineering, design, clinical, operations, commercial, regulatory, and other cross-functional stakeholders to translate user needs and business priorities into high-quality software solutions that can scale across multiple products and workflows.

Responsibilities include:

  • Lead product discovery for accountable products, including voice of customer, clinician workflow research, internal stakeholder feedback, data analysis, and assessment of unmet needs and pain points.
  • Define and maintain a prioritized roadmap, balancing clinician workflow needs, operational priorities, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and business impact.
  • Translate product strategy into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, release scope, and implementation plans that align business value, technical feasibility, regulatory considerations, and user experience.
  • Partner with program/project management to lead cross-functional core teams through product development, launch readiness, change management, and post-launch adoption.
  • Work closely with engineering, design, UX, clinical operations, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality features and intuitive workflows through iterative development.
  • Measure, analyze, and communicate product performance, adoption, operational impact, and KPI trends to inform roadmap decisions and demonstrate outcomes.
  • Willing to travel up to 20%.

About you:

You care deeply about building healthcare technology that improves workflows, supports clinicians, and enables better patient and customer outcomes. The end user is always your first priority, and you seek to understand day-to-day pain points through data, research, workflow observation, and direct stakeholder engagement. You know enough about software delivery, systems, and integrations to partner effectively with technical teams and can communicate complex ideas at the right level for executives, engineers, operators, and clinical stakeholders. You bring structure to ambiguity, make thoughtful tradeoffs, and communicate your rationale clearly so teams stay aligned and moving forward.

Desired Qualifications

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally with software platforms, workflow applications, or digital health products.
  • Experience in healthcare IT, medical device, digital health, clinical workflow, or regulated software environments.
  • Strong ability to define product scope, write clear requirements, prioritize effectively, and guide teams through ambiguity.
  • Exceptional communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional leadership skills.
  • Deep knowledge of product management best practices, including discovery, roadmap planning, agile delivery, launch readiness, and outcome measurement.
  • Strong end-user orientation, with experience gathering feedback from both internal and external users and translating insights into product decisions.
  • Experience using analytics, business intelligence, or product data to monitor adoption, workflow performance, and business impact.
  • Strong systems analysis, analytical reasoning, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrates initiative as a self-starter; results oriented, adaptable, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with Atlassian tools such as Jira and Confluence, road mapping tools such as Aha!, and analytics tools such as Tableau, Pendo, Google Analytics, or SQL.
  • BA/BS in science, engineering, business, healthcare, or a technical field. Advanced degree or MBA desired.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience building or improving applications that support multiple end-user personas and complex workflow handoffs.
  • Experience with clinician-facing software, care team workflows, reporting tools, patient monitoring platforms, or healthcare operations platforms.
  • Familiarity with EHR integrations, interoperability concepts, customer care systems, user management tools, or revenue cycle management workflows.
  • Experience with requirements management applications such as Jama or DOORS and design control applications such as MasterControl.
  • Technical fluency with software architecture, APIs, data flows, scripting, or object-oriented development concepts.
  • Experience leading cross-functional teams in a remote or distributed work environment.

Location:

Remote - US

Actual compensation may vary depending on job-related factors including knowledge, skills, experience, and work location.

Estimated Pay Range

$127,000.00 - $165,000.00

iRhythm is a leading digital healthcare company that creates trusted solutions that detect, predict, and prevent disease. About Edged Data Centers Edged is a fast-growing provider of sustainable data centers and energy infrastructure. The company builds and operates a global network of ultra-efficient, AI-ready data centers with waterless cooling for colocation, hyperscale and build-to-suit customers. The highly differentiated infrastructure platform is the first large-scale, global deployment of waterless cooling platform-wide and transforms data center growth into a catalyst for sustainable development. Edged is backed by a deep proprietary technology stack that will include renewable microgrid systems, ultra-clean generators, and waste-to-fuel solutions. The platform is designed for rapid deployment with more than a dozen new data centers operating or under construction across Europe and North America and a gigawatt-scale project pipeline. The North American division of Edged is a joint venture between one of the largest private multinational corporations in the world and an affiliate of Endeavour. Endeavour is a purpose-driven organization helping innovators to develop and launch breakthrough solutions for global challenges in the areas of energy, water, and waste. Endeavour companies are made up of passionate change-makers who want to leave the world better than the way we found it. Today, Endeavour is deploying solutions that are immediately scalable and deliver both high financial returns and positive impact, including EV charging, waterless data center cooling, and advanced energy systems.

Overview We are seeking a strategic and execution-focused leader to join our Data Center Operations team in a Central Operations role. This individual will serve as the bridge between operational coordination, systems governance, and program management across our data center portfolio. This role is responsible for overseeing a core team that owns the operational systems, driving standardization, and enabling consistent, reliable and high-quality execution across operations. The ideal candidate will bring strong experience in Data Center mission-critical environments and a passion for building scalable programs that improve reliability, efficiency, and operational visibility.

Key Responsibilities Centralized Operations Leadership

  • Serve as the central point of coordination for data center operations programs across all sites
  • Develop strategies to improve productivity, measuring performance and operational procedures
  • Partner with Facilities, IT, and Physical Security teams to ensure alignment, consistency, and execution of operational priorities
  • Lead standardization of processes, tools, and reporting across the portfolio
  • Provide direction, strategy and leadership to the Central Operations team
  • Champions a culture of knowledge sharing, ensuring best practices and lessons learned are disseminated across all sites

Incident Management

  • Supports quality audits in conjunction with operations, compliance, security and IT to manage site risk
  • Oversee the centralized command center for all DCs

Asset Management

  • Develop and maintain Edged Asset naming convention & labeling governance.
  • Responsible for quality assurance for asset meta data and equipment turn over from construction.
  • Oversee the Asset Management program including planning & scheduling, vendor management, asset tracking and warranty program.
  • Spare parts inventory management, requiring coordination with OEM, suppliers and establishing RSPL (Recommended Spare Parts List) for the data centers.

Process Standardization & Documentation

  • Develop and maintain standard operating procedures (SOPs), playbooks, and operational frameworks.
  • Ensure consistency in execution of maintenance, security, and IT operational processes.
  • Establish audit procedures to manage compliance and governance
  • Leverage SharePoint or similar platforms to maintain centralized, controlled documentation.

Data, Reporting & Insights

  • Support enterprise strategy for performance monitoring across all data centers, aligning KPIs and organizational objectives utilizing Power BI to drive efficiency, uptime, and customer satisfaction.
  • Develop and maintain reporting frameworks that provide visibility into key operational metrics (e.g., uptime, MTTR, MTBF, work order completion).
  • Analyze performance data to identify trends, gaps, and improvement opportunities.

Impact of the Role

  • Enables consistent, reliable operations across all data centers
  • Improves visibility, accountability, and performance through systems and data
  • Reduces operational risk and enhances uptime
  • Builds the foundation for scalable growth

Skills & Requirements Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, operations, or related field
  • 12+ years of experience in data center operations, mission-critical environments
  • Experience managing or administering CMMS and operational systems
  • Strong understanding of facility maintenance, critical infrastructure, incident management and uptime requirements
  • Experience in data center or colocation environments
  • Deep expertise with platforms such as SharePoint, Maximo, eMaint or similar systems
  • Experience with EHS systems and regulatory compliance
  • Knowledge of operational excellence methodologies (Lean, Six Sigma, etc.)
  • Experience building dashboards and analytics (Power BI, Tableau, etc.)

Leadership & Competencies

  • Strong systems thinker with attention to detail and scalability
  • Proven ability to operate both strategically and tactically
  • Excellent cross-functional collaboration and stakeholder management skills
  • Data-driven decision-maker with strong analytical capabilities

raw.description:
What you will do:

As an independent contractor, you will be working from home as a freelance transcriptionist and translator, making an accurate text document of the contents of audio, video, typed or handwritten material.

We transcribe oral history interviews (with WWII veterans, women in academia, farmers, midwives…), focus groups, financial forecasts or quarterly reports, tech webinars, commencement addresses, interviews about NGO work, educational reform or health care access, or anything else you could think of, and even occasionally TV shows. We don't do medical transcription.

Who we’re looking for:

  • U.S. Citizens or U.S. Resident Alien as described on IRS form W-9.
  • Bilingual transcriptionists/translators of Spanish and English.
  • Fast and accurate typists (minimum of 80 wpm), who can deliver files on deadline without question.
  • People with a wide range of interests or educational experiences. As the subject matter varies broadly, it’s easier to understand the flow of conversation when you have some context for what is being discussed.

Requirements

  • Strong language, style, and punctuation skills, and the capability and willingness to follow our transcription style manual as well as project-specific instructions.
  • Ability to verify names and terms via brief internet research. Much of the work we do is for archives, so these transcripts will become part of a historical record and need to be of high quality to reflect that permanence.

What you will need

  • A reliable internet connection is a must. ATC sends project files via Dropbox links, so no special FTP setup is necessary.
  • For confidentiality reasons, we require that you use an email address that no one else has access to.
  • Transcripts should be returned to ATC as .doc files. You are not strictly required to use Microsoft Word; you can also use Open Office or some other program that has the capability to save as a .doc file as long as the formatting requirements are met and the functionality of the end product is indistinguishable from a document completed in Word.
  • ATC highly recommends the use of transcription software (such as ExpressScribe) controlled via hotkeys or a foot pedal, and the use of good-quality headphones to cut down on ambient noise while you are transcribing.

How do I get hired as a freelance transcriptionist?

No calls, please. File your online application here and include:

  • Current resume (PDF)
  • Cover letter (PDF)
  • A screenshot of the results from a three-minute typing test on www.typingtest.com (our minimum requirement is 80 wpm with 98% accuracy)

raw.title: Senior Backend Software Engineer - Agent Platform
raw.excerpt: Our PurposeAt SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future.
raw.description:
Our Purpose

At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.

About Us

SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.

Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.

What Are We Looking For?

We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.

As a Senior Software Engineer on the Agent Platform team, you will help secure tens of millions of devices across Windows, Linux, and macOS while processing billions of security events every day as part of SentinelOne’s Endpoint Protection product line.

We are looking for an excellent software engineer with a reliability-first mindset who thrives on solving complex distributed systems challenges in production and turning those learnings into durable platform improvements and long-term engineering ownership.

You’ll help drive customer-critical incident response across the Agent Platform, rapidly build context across multiple platform services, and partner with engineering teams to continuously improve the platform’s reliability, operability, and scalability as a whole.

You will build and evolve the high-throughput, highly available services responsible for policy, configuration, and command distribution to millions of agents worldwide, while contributing to the agent platform protocols that enable other SentinelOne teams to deliver new security capabilities safely and at scale.

This role offers broad technical ownership, the opportunity to work across service boundaries, and the ability to influence the design and reliability of critical platform capabilities used throughout the Agent Platform at SentinelOne. You’ll solve some of the company’s most complex production challenges while helping shape the future of our platform.

What Will You Do?

Primary responsibilities include:

  • Drive rapid response to customer-critical incidents by diagnosing, triaging, and resolving complex production issues that span multiple services across the Agent Platform.
  • Lead systematic root-cause analysis and translate incident learnings into durable reliability, scalability, observability, and operability improvements.
  • Quickly build a systems-level understanding of unfamiliar services and codebases, collaborating closely with engineering teams to resolve complex cross-service issues.
  • Design, develop, test, document, deploy, and operate large-scale, high-volume, low-latency distributed systems processing millions of events per second.
  • Understand, maintain, and continuously improve existing services through refactoring, feature development, and architectural enhancements.
  • Maintain application stability and data integrity by monitoring key metrics, improving operational visibility, and continuously strengthening the codebase.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into robust, scalable, and operable technical solutions.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams across SentinelOne to solve cross-functional problems, influence technical direction, and deliver solutions that scale.
  • Continuously evaluate and adopt technologies that improve the platform’s scalability, reliability, and operational excellence.

Your Toolkit

  • Our backend services are primarily developed in Java, with Go and Python also playing important roles.
  • We use gRPC, REST, GraphQL, and Kafka for service communication.
  • Our data layer includes Redis, PostgreSQL, Cassandra, ClickHouse, and our own columnar time-series database.
  • Our services run across multiple AWS and GCP regions on Kubernetes, using Docker, GitHub, and ArgoCD.
  • We provide engineers with modern AI-powered tools to improve both engineering productivity and software quality.

What Skills and Knowledge Will You Bring?

Ideal candidates will have:

  • 5+ years of professional backend software engineering experience with deep expertise in at least one of Java, Go, or Python, and the willingness to work across all three as needed.
  • A reliability-first mindset with a proven ability to solve complex production incidents, perform systematic root-cause analysis, and implement durable engineering solutions that prevent recurrence.
  • Demonstrated ability to quickly understand unfamiliar distributed systems, navigate large codebases, and troubleshoot complex failures across service boundaries.
  • Strong hands-on experience designing, building, and operating large-scale distributed systems, with a deep understanding of failure modes, performance trade-offs, resilience patterns, and operational excellence.
  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or similar cloud platforms, as well as Docker, Helm, and Kubernetes.
  • Experience with messaging systems and data platforms such as Kafka, PostgreSQL, Redis, Cassandra, ClickHouse, or similar technologies.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across engineering teams, Product, Technical Account Managers, and other stakeholders, influence technical direction, and mentor fellow engineers.
  • A high degree of ownership, autonomy, curiosity, and the ability to drive ambiguous technical problems to successful outcomes.
  • Experience in an enterprise SaaS or cybersecurity software company is highly desirable.

Why SentinelOne?

AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.

We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:

Equity & Rewards

  • Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)
  • Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)

Time Off & Wellbeing

  • Flexible time off
  • Paid company holidays and paid sick time
  • Gender-neutral parental leave
  • Grandparent leave

Insurance & Financial Security

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Life and disability insurance
  • Health and dependent care FSA
  • Voluntary benefits (hospital, accident, critical illness)
  • Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
  • ARAG pre-paid legal
  • Nationwide pet insurance
  • Cancer Care program
  • Global business travel medical insurance

Work Perks & Flexibility

  • Home office allowance
  • Mobile phone reimbursement

Wellness & Lifestyle

  • Wellness coach
  • Wellness/gym reimbursement
  • Fertility coverage
  • Adoption & surrogacy reimbursement

This U.S. role has a base pay range that will vary based on the location of the candidate. For some locations, a different pay range may apply. If so, this range will be provided to you during the recruiting process. You can also reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

$132,000—$182,000 USD

raw.description:
The Media Specialist is responsible for the hands-on setup, activation, monitoring, and day-to-day management of media campaigns within an assigned marketing channel. Channels may include Programmatic, Paid Search, Paid Social, or other emerging performance media channels.

Reporting to the Performance Media Strategy leader and working under the guidance of a Senior Media Specialist, this role ensures campaigns are built accurately, launched on schedule, and monitored against client objectives, regulatory requirements, platform best practices, and operational standards. The Media Specialist executes optimization actions, prepares performance reporting, and escalates delivery risks for senior review.

This is a developing practitioner role. The ideal candidate has foundational platform experience in at least one performance media channel, strong attention to detail, and a demonstrated interest in building channel depth. Experience in a financial institution, agency, or other regulated marketing environment is preferred but not required.

Key Responsibilities

Campaign Activation and Management (50%)

  • Build and traffic digital media campaigns within the assigned channel against approved strategies, budgets, targeting parameters, and client objectives.
  • Complete campaign setup tasks including audience configuration, budget and flight entry, tracking implementation, and pre-launch quality assurance checklists.
  • Monitor daily delivery, pacing, and performance against established KPIs and flag variances to the Senior Media Specialist or Strategy leader.
  • Identify execution issues, tracking discrepancies, and delivery challenges, and resolve routine issues or escalate complex ones with supporting detail.
  • Maintain accurate campaign documentation, naming conventions, and trafficking records in line with operational processes and standards.

Optimization and Reporting (25%)

  • Execute optimization actions such as bid, budget, placement, audience, and creative adjustments under senior guidance.
  • Pull, assemble, and quality check campaign performance reporting for internal and client-facing use.
  • Track key performance indicators including engagement, conversions, acquisition metrics, pacing, and media efficiency.
  • Summarize performance observations and surface opportunities and risks to senior team members.
  • Support test execution by implementing agreed test structures and capturing results accurately.

Channel Skill Development (15%)

  • Build working knowledge of platform capabilities, targeting methodologies, product updates, and industry best practices within the assigned channel.
  • Complete platform certifications and training relevant to the assigned channel.
  • Apply established playbooks and channel best practices consistently across campaigns.
  • Contribute observations from day-to-day execution that inform process improvement and automation opportunities.
  • Use AI-enabled tools and automation solutions available to the team to improve campaign setup, reporting, and optimization workflows.

Compliance, Governance, and Collaboration (10%)

  • Follow client requirements, industry regulations, platform policies, and financial services compliance standards in all campaign work.
  • Coordinate with Client Services, Analytics, Product, Creative, and Operations teams throughout campaign lifecycles.
  • Provide accurate campaign detail to support performance reviews and client discussions.
  • Escalate performance concerns, operational risks, or compliance questions promptly.

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Advertising, Communications, Business, or a related field preferred.

Experience

  • 2 to 4 years of experience in digital media, performance marketing, media buying, campaign management, or marketing operations.
  • Hands-on experience executing campaigns in at least one performance media channel.
  • Experience in a financial institution, agency, marketing services, or other performance-driven environment preferred.
  • Exposure to regulated industries or compliance-sensitive marketing programs is a plus.

Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities

  • Working knowledge of at least one performance media channel with the ability to execute independently on routine campaign work.
  • Familiarity with conversion tracking, audience targeting, and standard digital media metrics.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret campaign reporting.
  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills across multiple concurrent campaigns.
  • Clear written and verbal communication and effective collaboration across cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to learn new platforms and technologies quickly and apply feedback from senior team members.
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.

Salary Range: $80,000 - $100,000

Applications will be accepted until the posted deadline September 30th or until a sufficient candidate pool has been identified.

WHAT WE BELIEVE
At Vericast, we believe what’s good for people is good for business. Everything we do starts from a place of
purpose to drive meaningful impact for our clients, our people and our communities.

We’ve cultivated a culture of collaboration, a heritage of innovation and a focus on workplace flexibility.
Every day you will have the opportunity to bring your passion and expertise to create opportunities to grow

and thrive.

Together, let’s advance performance for all.

At Vericast, we don’t just accept differences - we celebrate them, we support them, and we thrive on them for the benefit of our employees, our clients, and our community. As an Equal Opportunity employer, Vericast considers applicants for all positions without regard to race, color, creed, religion, national origin or ancestry, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other classifications protected by law. Applicants who have disabilities may request that accommodations be made in order to complete the selection process by contacting our Talent Acquisition team at . EEO is the law. To review your rights under Equal Employment Opportunity please visit:

Vericast is the financial institution (FI) performance partner. We help banks and credit unions drive growth, improve efficiency, increase engagement and navigate change through the power of data, technology and people. Our advanced analytics, data-driven insights and integrated solution set enable better execution with agility, precision and scale. That’s why thousands of financial institutions look to Vericast and our 150 years of financial services expertise to help them achieve more.

raw.excerpt: About KinaxisAre you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career?
raw.description:
About Kinaxis

Are you looking to join an innovative, market-leading company where you can truly elevate your career? At Kinaxis we are serious about culture, we are serious about technology, we are serious about customers, and we are serious about not taking ourselves too seriously. If you are looking to be part of an incredible growth story, then we might just be the place for you!

In 1984, we started out as a team of three engineers. Today, we have grown to become a global organization with over 2000 employees around the world, 6 global office and a best-in-class HQ in Ottawa, Canada. As winners of several Top Employer awards globally, we are proud to work with our customers and employees towards solving some of the biggest challenges facing supply chains today.

Kinaxis is a global leader in modern supply chain orchestration, powering complex global supply chains, and supporting the people who manage them. Our powerful, AI infused platform provides full transparency and visibility across end-to-end supply chains, enabling our customers to make faster, better decisions. We are trusted by renowned global brands to provide the agility and predictability needed to navigate today’s volatility and disruption. With more than 40,000 users in over 100 countries, we are expanding our team as we continue to innovate and revolutionize how we support our customers.

Location

This is a remote role. You can work from home and be located anywhere in Ireland

About the team

The Employee Relations Specialist, EMEA is responsible for providing expert employee relations support across the EMEA region. Acting as a trusted advisor to managers, HR Business Partners, Legal, and key stakeholders, this role manages complex employee relations matters, supports organizational change initiatives, and ensures compliance with local employment legislation and consultation requirements across multiple EMEA jurisdictions.

The successful candidate will bring significant employee relations experience supporting EMEA employees and leaders, including practical knowledge of employee representative structures, Works Councils, consultation obligations, and country-specific employment requirements. 

What you will do

  • Manage complex employee relations casework across EMEA, including performance management, probation reviews and extensions, disciplinary matters, grievances, investigations, and terminations. 
  • Provide coaching and guidance to managers on complex employee relations matters, employment legislation, global and local HR policies, and HR processes. 
  • Support managers in navigating sensitive employee matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and legally compliant outcomes. 
  • Conduct thorough, objective, and timely investigations into workplace concerns, policy violations, misconduct allegations, and employee complaints.
  • Support the establishment of and ongoing collaboration with employee representative bodies, including Works Councils. 
  • Manage consultation activities and ensure compliance with local statutory requirements and employee representative obligations. 
  • Conduct country-specific legal processes as required.
  • Guide leaders and employees through the accommodation process, ensuring equitable treatment and consistent application of policy and employment legislation.
  • Identify trends and themes across employee relations activity and escalate complex or high-risk matters as appropriate. 
  • Support organizational change initiatives, restructures, acquisitions, workforce reductions, and business transformation activities. 
  • Partner with Legal, HR Business Partners, and business leaders on complex employee relations matters. 
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of employee relations processes, documentation, manager capability, and best practices across EMEA. 

What we are looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Relations, Labour Relations, or a related field. 
  • Minimum 5 years of Employee Relations experience supporting multiple EMEA countries. 
  • Demonstrated experience with Works Councils, employee representative bodies, and consultation processes. 
  • Experience managing EMEA-based investigations, disciplinary matters, grievances, performance management, probation management, and terminations. 
  • Strong knowledge of employment legislation and employee relations practices across EMEA jurisdictions. 
  • Experience supporting organizational change initiatives and restructures in EMEA. 
  • Experience partnering with Legal, HR Advisors/Business Partners, and leaders on complex employee relations matters.  
  • Ability to analyze data and trends to identify potential employee relations issues and develop proactive solutions.
  • Ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels within the organization.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills to effectively interact with employees, managers, and senior leadership.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced organization and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to maintain a high level of discretion, confidentiality, and integrity
  • Ability to work effectively across multiple time zones and cultures.

Work With Impact: Our platform directly helps companies power the world’s supply chains. We see the results of what we do out in the world every day, when we see store shelves stocked, when medications are available for our loved ones, and so much more.

Work with Fortune 500 Brands: Companies across industries trust us to help them take control of their integrated business planning and digital supply chain. Some of our customers include Lockheed Martin, Unilever, P&G, ExxonMobil, Cisco and more.

Social Responsibility at Kinaxis: Our Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion Committee weighs in on hiring practices, talent assessment training materials, and mandatory training on unconscious bias and inclusion fundamentals. Sustainability is key to what we do and we’re committed to a long-term net-zero operations strategy. We are involved in our communities and support causes where we can make the most impact.

People matter at Kinaxis and here are some of the perks and benefits we offer, which may vary by location and employee:

  • Flexible vacation and Kinaxis Days (company-wide days off)
  • Flexible work options
  • Physical and mental well-being programs
  • Regularly scheduled virtual fitness classes
  • Mentorship programs, training, and career development
  • Recognition programs and referral rewards
  • Hackathons

For more information, visit the Kinaxis website at www.kinaxis.com or the company’s blog at
