raw.title: Security Operations Analyst
raw.excerpt: Who we are.  Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally.
raw.description:
Who we are.

Newfold Digital is a leading web technology company serving millions of customers globally. Our customers know us through our robust portfolio of brands. We have some of the industry's most prominent and storied go-to-market brands, including Bluehost, HostGator, Domain.com, Network Solutions, Register.com and Web.com. We help customers of all sizes build a digital presence that delivers results. With our extensive product offerings and personalized support, we take pride in collaborating with our customers to serve their online presence needs. The strength of our company lives in the intersection of our people, our customers, and our brands.

About the role:

Security Operations Analyst is responsible for the day-to-day monitoring, analysis, and investigation of security threats across enterprise systems and networks. The role triages and responds to security alerts and incidents, working both independently and in collaboration with senior analysts on known or suspected threats.

The analyst supports incident response, threat intelligence, and forensic analysis activities in alignment with established security best practices and control frameworks. This includes identifying anomalies, escalating issues as appropriate, and contributing to the improvement of detection and response processes.

Security Operations Analysts may work shifts and participate in on-call rotations to support global operations and ensure continuous security monitoring coverage.

What you’ll do & how you’ll make your mark:

  • Develop and deliver security reports and metrics to support operational awareness and leadership decision-making.

  • Identify and support mitigation of information security risks, including evaluating projects and initiatives for alignment with security requirements, policies, and standards.

  • Support internal and external audits by collecting and analyzing evidence, assessing control effectiveness, and ensuring adherence to established security frameworks and policies.

  • Track and manage remediation activities, including corrective action plans and audit findings, ensuring timely resolution of identified security issues.

  • Identify, investigate, and respond to security incidents, including analyzing root cause and impact to contain threats and reduce organizational risk.

  • Maintain and support security tools, controls, and monitoring capabilities to ensure effective detection and response.

  • Develop, implement, and continuously improve threat-informed detections and automated response playbooks, including use case development, rule creation, tuning, validation, and optimization through incident feedback and testing.

  • Monitor systems and security telemetry for violations, vulnerabilities, and anomalous activity.

  • Analyze and apply threat intelligence to enhance detection, response, and situational awareness.

  • Identify and support onboarding and validation of security telemetry to ensure effective detection and visibility.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to support incident response, remediation, and security improvements.

  • Assist in the evaluation and selection of security technologies and solutions to support detection, monitoring, and response capabilities.

Who you are & what you’ll need to succeed:

  • A degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field is desirable.

  • Industry-recognized certifications are a plus and may include: CompTIA Security+ or CySA+, Microsoft SC-200, GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), GIAC Certified Incident Handler (GCIH), GIAC Certified Intrusion Analyst (GCIA), GIAC Cyber Threat Intelligence (GCTI), GIAC Security Operations Certified (GSOC), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), and relevant cloud or security vendor certifications (e.g., SIEM, SOAR, endpoint, or cloud security platforms).

  • 5-7 years of experience in security operations or related disciplines. with demonstrated expertise in security analysis and incident response.

  • Working knowledge of security controls including access control, authentication, encryption, system integrity, and logging as applied to security monitoring and detection.

  • Experience with security operations including monitoring, incident response, and incident management procedures, with the ability to investigate, escalate, and respond to security events.

  • Ability to develop, modify, and maintain threat detection rules within SIEM platforms, including tuning alerts and improving detection fidelity.

  • Understanding of security telemetry, including log collection and ingestion (e.g., syslog, Windows Event Forwarding, ELK), normalization, and data quality considerations to support effective detection and visibility.

  • Strong knowledge of operating systems (Windows, Linux, macOS), identity systems (e.g., Active Directory), and network fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS) as they relate to security monitoring and investigation.

  • Experience with endpoint, network, and host-based security tools including EDR, IDS/IPS, firewalls, vulnerability scanners, and host-based detection/prevention systems.

  • Ability to analyze and correlate data across multiple security and telemetry sources to identify patterns, anomalies, vulnerabilities, and potential security threats.

  • Experience applying security frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK to map adversary behaviors and support detection and response development.

  • Experience with malware analysis, network forensics, and digital forensics concepts and tools; reverse engineering skills are a plus.

  • Ability to assess security threats and implement timely mitigations under pressure.

  • Experience using scripting languages such as Python, PowerShell, or equivalent to support automation, analysis, and response activities.

  • Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to build effective relationships across technical and non-technical teams.

  • Experience with security platforms and tools including SIEM, SOAR, EDR, vulnerability management, and threat intelligence tools (e.g., Google SecOps/Chronicle, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, SentinelOne Singularity, Tanium Threat Response, Recorded Future).

  • Experience with cloud security monitoring and native security services across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or OCI is a plus.

  • Familiarity with security-focused frameworks, methodologies, and best practices for detection, response, and vulnerability management is a plus.

  • Ability to analyze and apply threat intelligence to support detection, investigation, and response activities.

  • Experience developing or working with automated response workflows and playbooks (SOAR).

  • Advanced professional role requiring strong technical proficiency in security operations, detection, and incident response. Works independently with minimal supervision on complex investigations, exercising sound judgment to resolve issues, identify risks, and escalate appropriately.

  • Serves as a senior technical resource for the team, providing guidance, mentorship, and cross-training to junior analysts while promoting consistent standards for analysis, detection, and response. Contributes to the development and continuous improvement of detection logic, alert tuning, and response playbooks.

  • Effectively communicates with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and collaborates with peers on complex issues to enhance team capability. May assist in coordinating and tracking tasks for junior team members.

This Job Description includes the essential job functions required to perform the job described above, as well as additional duties and responsibilities. This Job Description is not an exhaustive list of all functions that the employee performing this job may be required to perform. The Company reserves the right to revise the Job Description at any time, and to require the employee to perform functions in addition to those listed above.

Funciones

  • Gestión y evolución de plataformas virtualizadas e infraestructuras críticas.

Job ID: 15481

Alternate Locations:

Newell Brands is a leading consumer products company with a portfolio of iconic brands like Graco®, Coleman®, Oster®, Rubbermaid®, Sharpie® and Yankee Candle® - and 24,000 talented teammates around the world. Our culture is built on values in action: Integrity, Teamwork, Passion for Winning, Ownership, and Leadership. We work together to win, grow, and make a real impact—supported by a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative environment where you can be your best, every day.

Position Summary

The Maintenance AI Technology Training Specialist is responsible for developing, delivering and continuously improving enterprise-wide training programs that accelerate adoption of digital maintenance tools, mobile technology and AI-supported troubleshooting across Newell Brands manufacturing sites globally.

Building on deep, hands-on maintenance expertise, this individual designs curricula tailored to adult learners on the shop floor and delivers instruction in person and remotely across North American and international sites. As the enterprise subject-matter authority on digital maintenance practices, the Global Training Lead partners with technicians, maintenance leaders and ERA/IT teams to drive measurable improvements in equipment uptime, work order quality and first-time-fix rates.

Responsibilities:

Curriculum Design & Adult Learning

  • Design, develop and maintain a structured maintenance digitization curriculum — including course outlines, learning objectives, assessments and job aids — grounded in adult learning principles (e.g., experiential, competency-based instruction).
  • Create and update quick-reference guides, e-learning modules and blended learning materials that translate complex digital tool workflows into practical, shop-floor-ready instruction.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve training content based on learner feedback, adoption metrics and evolving tool capabilities.
  • Adapt delivery formats and instructional approaches to diverse learner populations, including frontline technicians, lead technicians and maintenance supervisors.

Training Delivery — In Person & Remote

  • Deliver instructor-led training on-site at manufacturing facilities globally, including hands-on, shift-integrated coaching sessions.
  • Facilitate virtual instructor-led training via video conferencing platform for remote sites and follow-up reinforcement sessions.
  • Provide real-time floor coaching to reinforce skills immediately after formal training, bridging the gap between classroom instruction and day-to-day practice.

Global Travel & Site Support

  • Travel globally (estimated 50% annually) to support site deployments, conduct in-person training and assess adoption health — including travel internationally as the program expands.
  • Serve as the on-site training authority during go-live periods, providing sustained presence and support through the critical adoption window.
  • Develop site-specific training plans that account for shift schedules, language considerations and local maintenance practices.

Digital & AI Tool Enablement

  • Train maintenance teams on tablets, mobile devices, CMMS platforms, digital work order workflows and AI-supported diagnostic tools, including image-based troubleshooting.
  • Serve as a primary liaison between ERA, IT, and site maintenance teams to ensure training content reflects current tool configurations and release updates.
  • Identify capability gaps and design targeted intervention programs to close them efficiently.

Adoption Measurement & Continuous Improvement

  • Define and track leading training indicators — learner completion, assessment scores, tool utilization rates and work order quality metrics — to demonstrate training effectiveness.
  • Provide structured feedback to ERA and enterprise product teams on usability, tool gaps and enhancement opportunities observed during training delivery.
  • Capture and codify lessons learned, success stories and site-specific best practices to build a reusable training knowledge base scalable across the enterprise.
  • Contribute to regional and global maintenance excellence forums to share best practices and inform program direction.

Qualifications:

Education & Experience

  • Required: High school diploma or equivalent; technical certification or trade school credential strongly preferred.
  • Required: 5+ years of hands-on maintenance experience in a manufacturing or industrial environment, with demonstrated proficiency in equipment troubleshooting and end-to-end maintenance processes.
  • Required: 2+ years of experience training or teaching adult learners in a manufacturing, technical or industrial setting — including development of training materials and facilitation of structured learning sessions.
  • Required: Demonstrated experience developing and executing training curricula or instructional programs specifically designed for adult learners (e.g., competency-based training, on-the-job training frameworks, blended learning programs).

Delivery & Communication Skills

  • Proven ability to deliver effective instruction both in person on the plant floor and via remote/virtual platform.
  • Strong facilitation skills — able to engage mixed-experience audiences, manage group dynamics and adapt delivery pace and depth in real time.
  • Ability to translate complex technical concepts into clear, practical guidance accessible to frontline technicians.
  • Comfort presenting to and collaborating with maintenance leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

Technical & Digital Proficiency

  • Proficiency with tablets, mobile devices and standard productivity applications; ability to quickly learn and teach new digital tools.
  • Familiarity with AI-enabled diagnostic tools or strong aptitude and curiosity for rapidly adopting emerging technologies.

Travel & Mobility

  • Ability and willingness to travel globally — approximately 50% annually — to manufacturing sites across North America and internationally as the program expands.
  • Valid passport or ability to obtain one.

Leadership & Professional Capabilities

  • Proven track record of driving change in a peer or coaching capacity — influencing adoption without formal authority.
  • Continuous improvement mindset with a bias toward scalable, practical solutions.
  • Self-directed and accountable; comfortable operating in an evolving, high-visibility enterprise role.

The base pay range for this position is from $84,000 to $115,500. Salary will be based on prior experience related to the skills required for this position.

Newell Brands (NASDAQ: NWL) is a leading global consumer goods company with a strong portfolio of well-known brands, including Rubbermaid, Sharpie, Graco, Coleman, Rubbermaid Commercial Products, Yankee Candle, Paper Mate, FoodSaver, Dymo, EXPO, Elmer’s, Oster, NUK, Spontex and Campingaz. Why this role is on the menu

Instacart's Strategic Finance team partners across the business to drive disciplined growth and long-term value creation. Within this group, Consolidation is responsible for being the aggregated source of truth for how Instacart performs and where it's headed. As Director, Strategic Finance – Consolidation, you will own this responsibility and sit at the center of our financial ecosystem — integrating inputs from Accounting, other parts of StratFin, Business Operations teams, Investor Relations, and more — into one coherent, reconciled, and forward-looking view of the company.

This is a high-visibility role at the heart of Instacart's financial governance. Reporting to the Vice President of Investor Relations and Strategic Finance, you will be the architect of our consolidated P&L forecast, our long-range financial model, and the financial narratives that inform our Board, investors, and executive team. As Instacart continues to mature as a public company, this function is foundational to how we govern the business and tell our financial story.

The ideal candidate is a rigorous financial operator and natural integrator — someone who sees the forest, not just the trees. You know how to land the quarter while simultaneously anticipating what's around short-, medium-, and long-term corners. You consolidate narratives and key business insights across teams into a single, coherent point of view. You earn the trust of senior stakeholders through consistently high-quality work, lead a high-performing team, and set the bar for what great looks like.

What you'll cook up in your first year

Own the consolidated financial view

  • A single, reconciled consolidated P&L forecast is in place and trusted — integrating inputs from the broader StratFin team, Accounting, Business Operations, Investor Relations and more.
  • The monthly and quarterly close cycle runs on time and at executive-quality standards, with variance analysis and management reporting packages that connect results to business drivers — not just numbers on a page.
  • A GAAP and non-GAAP long-range financial model (5-year) reflects current strategy and updated assumptions, with scenario analysis that helps leadership anticipate what's around the corner.
  • The annual budgeting process is orchestrated end-to-end, with company-level targets set clearly and cross-functional alignment secured.

Be the financial narrator for Instacart's story

  • Board decks, investor materials, and quarterly business review packages are delivered consistently — accurate, insightful, and requiring minimal revision from senior leadership.
  • Our weekly consolidated P&L outlook is a trusted executive staple, surfacing not just what happened, but what it means and what's coming.
  • Cross-team narratives and business insights are synthesized into a single, coherent point of view — so leadership always knows where the business stands and what decisions need to be made.

Build the infrastructure that makes it all scalable

  • Forecasting processes that are repeatable, auditable, and aligned with Accounting's close process.
  • Business Unit P&Ls are designed and live, enabling clearer accountability and more rigorous investment decisions.
  • Internal capital allocation decisions are timely, organized and effective — providing financial frameworks to seamlessly align and execute key business decisions.

Grow the team and raise the bar

  • A high-performing team is operating at a consistently elevated standard — stronger analytical rigor, sharper business judgment, and clear ownership across the function.
  • Cross-functional partners — including the CFO, Strategic Finance, Accounting, Investor Relations, Legal, and other Business partners — rely on this function as a proactive, trusted advisor, not just a reporting engine.

The secret ingredients we're looking for

Must-have pantry staples (Minimum Qualifications)

  • 12+ years of experience in a relevant field with demonstrated financial acumen and a track record of leveraging data to drive business impact
  • Proven experience in FP&A, Corporate Finance, or Strategic Finance at a high-growth or public technology company, with direct ownership of consolidated financial reporting and forecasting processes
  • Deep understanding of GAAP financial statements and comfort operating across both GAAP and non-GAAP financial frameworks
  • High proficiency in advanced Excel/Sheets with a demonstrated ability to build and maintain complex, enterprise-grade financial models
  • Trusted partner to cross-functional leadership, including Accounting, IR, and Business Ops; effectively influences stakeholders to secure alignment on complex strategic recommendations
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills—able to distill complex financial data into crisp, actionable narratives for the Board, C-suite, and business partners
  • Strong people management experience with a track record of developing high-performing Finance teams and raising the bar on analytical quality and process discipline
  • Ability to manage multiple competing priorities, and deliver in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment

Optional garnishes (Preferred Qualifications)

  • MBA preferred
  • Experience building or significantly transforming a consolidation or Corporate/Strategic Finance function, particularly in the context of a high-paced, newly public company.
  • Familiarity with financial planning systems such as Adaptive, Oracle, Workiva, Pigment, Anaplan, or similar enterprise FP&A tools
  • Intermediate to advanced SQL proficiency—comfortable leveraging datasets to pressure-test assumptions, improve reporting, and uncover actionable insights
  • Experience with consumer marketplace businesses or on-demand commerce
  • Demonstrated enthusiasm for applying AI and automation tools to financial forecasting, reporting, and analytical workflows
  • Ability to work from our San Francisco or New York City office on occasion

The Inside Sales Representative owns proactive cross-sell and category-penetration performance for a regional portfolio of smaller-revenue, single-location accounts: customers who already order from Odeko but aren't buying across the full range of categories available to them.

This is a fully remote, digital-first selling role with very few to no in-person visits. Success means knowing how to build customer trust and grow revenue entirely through phone, email, in-app, and other remote channels, and doing it proactively rather than waiting on inbound requests.

This is a build role: you'll be one of the first two people establishing this function, reporting directly to the Chief Revenue Officer while it's being established.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own cross-sell and category-penetration performance for an assigned regional portfolio (West Coast) of existing single-location accounts.
  • Identify white-space opportunities per account — categories or products a customer isn't yet ordering — and run targeted, proactive campaigns to close those gaps.
  • Build and execute remote, digital-first outreach (phone, email, in-app, SMS) suited to your region's customer base; there's no in-person coverage, so channel and cadence choices matter.
  • Sell pallet-quantity orders into accounts that sit outside Odeko's local delivery radius — identifying which out-of-radius and pickup-only customers can be served profitably on a pallet/freight model, sizing the order to make the freight work, and building a repeat ordering cadence with them.
  • Recommend cross-sell offers with account margin in mind, not just top-line revenue.
  • Use CRM and reporting tools (HubSpot, Looker or similar) to prioritize which accounts and moments are worth the outreach.
  • Partner with in-field Market Managers and Market Operations to keep account ownership clean as customers move between remote and field coverage.
  • Surface recurring feedback, objections, and category-adoption barriers to Marketing and Category teams so upstream teams can act on patterns, not just individual cases.
  • Track your own performance against category adoption and satisfaction targets, and refine your approach based on what's working.

What Success Looks Like

Performance in this role will be measured through:

  • Category adoption / basket expansion across your portfolio
  • Net Promoter Score (NPS) across your portfolio
  • Revenue growth from cross-sell within your portfolio

Key Partners

  • Market Operations
  • In-field Market Managers and Regional Sales leadership
  • Marketing Communications / Category teams

What We're Looking For

  • 2–4 years in inside sales, account management, or customer success for a distributed account base: backgrounds in distribution, foodservice, CPG, or subscription/tech-enabled services are all relevant.
  • Comfortable running a proactive, remote-first selling motion
  • Strong written and remote communication skills; comfortable selling entirely through phone, email, and digital channels.
  • Fluency with CRM tools (HubSpot or similar) and comfort using dashboards (Looker or similar) to prioritize a book of accounts.
  • A consultative mindset: comfortable recommending what's right for the account and for Odeko's margin, not just pushing volume.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in coffee, beverage, or independent/small-business retail distribution.
  • Experience in a newly-formed or early-stage sales function.

Compensation for this role is $65,000 base + OTE $78,000

What you’ll love about Odeko:

  • Fast-paced environment and growth opportunities - plenty of room for you to directly impact the company and enhance your career!
  • Competitive compensation, healthcare benefits, and opportunity for equity
  • Other great perks - Full lists of benefits available upon request

Odeko is proud to be a diverse, equitable, and inclusive employer. We encourage all to apply regardless of educational background, race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status.

raw.description:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit .

About the Team

Reddit's developer ecosystem is one of the biggest opportunities to make Reddit more useful, expressive, extensible, and valuable. Today, most people who build on Reddit are developers: they write code, use Devvit, work with APIs, and ship apps or games through a relatively technical workflow. That ecosystem is growing quickly and remains critical.

But the future is bigger than developers alone. AI-assisted building is changing who can create software. The next generation of Reddit apps, games, tools, community agents, content formats, and workflows should be buildable by many more people: developers, technically curious creators, moderators, community builders, game designers, data partners, and eventually people who can describe what they want without needing to code it by hand.

The Developer Ecosystem team owns the product systems that help this broader set of builders discover opportunities, create successfully, launch high-quality apps and games, reach the right users and communities, adopt new platform capabilities, and keep improving after launch. This includes surfaces and systems like developers.reddit.com, AI-assisted creation, app review, developer and creator onboarding, app marketplace experiences, platform capabilities, best practices, and support for emerging creator categories.

About the Role

We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead Reddit's Builder Ecosystem product strategy. This person will define the roadmap for how Reddit moves from a developer-only ecosystem to a broader builder ecosystem where AI-assisted and no-code creation become first-class parts of the platform.

The role spans developer growth, creator onboarding, AI-assisted building, app quality, ecosystem incentives, platform capabilities, app marketplace strategy, operational tooling, feature adoption, and new builder categories.

This is a high-ambiguity platform role with direct business, product, and community impact. The right PM will be able to bridge two worlds: they should understand the needs of serious developers and platform engineers, while also having strong conviction that Reddit can unlock a much larger wave of builders by making creation more accessible, guided, AI-native, and outcome-oriented.

What You'll Do

  • Define the product strategy for Reddit's Developer Ecosystem, including the transition from code-first developers to a broader base of AI-assisted creators.
  • Own the roadmap for developers.reddit.com as the primary builder portal, including onboarding, docs, app management, analytics, review status, feature access, education, examples, templates, and AI-assisted creation entry points.
  • Lead strategy for AI-assisted app creation, including prompt-to-app workflows, AI building tools, no-code or low-code experiences, reusable templates, generated scaffolds, and systems that help creators turn ideas into useful Reddit-native apps.
  • Build the product approach for an App Marketplace that helps users, moderators, communities, and internal teams discover high-quality apps, games, agents, tools, and community experiences.
  • Improve app review and ecosystem operations through tooling, automation, and AI-assisted workflows, including LLM-powered app review, policy checks, quality signals, and reviewer efficiency.
  • Partner with Engineering to prioritize core platform capabilities and performance improvements such as webhooks, webviews, APIs, SDKs, tooling, observability, and other primitives builders need to create reliable apps.
  • Drive more successful, retentive, and popular apps and games by identifying best practices, improving templates, shaping incentives, and creating clearer paths from idea to launch to growth.
  • Identify and support new creator and developer categories
  • Partner with internal teams such as Contribution, Community Builders, Games, Search, Recommendations, Safety, and Ads to help them launch new functionality through the developer ecosystem.
  • Define and improve feature adoption programs so builders understand, test, and successfully use new platform capabilities.
  • Work with developer relations to establish the measurement system for the ecosystem, including weekly active developers/creators, NPS/CSAT, app launches, app retention and more
  • Create clear frameworks for when Reddit should build platform primitives, launch templates, fund builders, partner with external teams, promote apps, or shut down low-quality or low-trust ecosystem behavior.
  • Lead cross-functional alignment across Product, Engineering, DevRel, Community, Data, Safety, Legal, Policy, Support, BD, and senior leadership.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience leading high-ambiguity platform, developer ecosystem, creator ecosystem, marketplace, gaming, AI tooling, or developer experience products.
  • Strong product judgment for creation platforms: understanding what makes a platform powerful for advanced developers, approachable for new creators, trustworthy for communities, and worth sustained investment.
  • Comfort with code, APIs, developer tools, technical platform tradeoffs, and engineering conversations, paired with strong conviction that AI-assisted and no-code creation will expand who can build on Reddit.
  • Ability to reason across multiple sides of the ecosystem: developers, creators, users, moderators, communities, internal teams, partners, and Reddit's business priorities.
  • Experience improving developer or creator onboarding, docs, portals, SDKs, APIs, marketplaces, app review, app distribution, AI creation tools, or app-building workflows.
  • Strong analytical judgment and comfort defining metrics for ecosystem health, builder productivity, app quality, retention, distribution, and business impact.
  • Ability to partner deeply with Engineering on platform capabilities, performance, reliability, primitives, observability, and build-vs-buy decisions.
  • Strong product sense for apps, games, agents, content creation tools, community-native experiences, and the kinds of lightweight software that should exist inside Reddit communities.
  • Comfort working with AI-assisted creation tools, LLM-based workflows, prompt-to-app systems, or other emerging ways of helping more people build software.
  • Excellent written communication and decision frameworks that help teams make crisp investment decisions in ambiguous spaces.

Benefits:

  • Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs
  • 401k with Employer Match
  • Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support
  • Family Planning Support
  • Gender-Affirming Care
  • Mental Health & Coaching Benefits
  • Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off
  • Generous Paid Parental Leave

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

The base salary range for this position is:
$217,000—$303,900 USD

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision. For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors.

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. Job Summary:

The Digital Marketing Specialist will support the execution and optimization of digital marketing initiatives that drive lead generation and brand visibility across Sola Salons’ national and local markets. This role works across paid media, SEO, website optimization, and analytics, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and data-driven decision-making.

This position is ideal for a hands-on digital marketer who enjoys working across channels, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and wants to continue building expertise in performance marketing for a multi-location brand. This role reports to the Director of Digital Marketing and collaborates closely with internal teams and external partners.

Primary Responsibilities:

Paid Media & Campaign Management

  • Execute and optimize paid digital campaigns across channels including Google and Bing Ads, Meta, TikTok, Performance Max, and emerging platforms, in alignment with established strategies.
  • Monitor campaign performance and optimize toward lead generation and conversion goals.
  • Assist with audience targeting, campaign builds, creative testing, budget pacing, and reporting.
  • Partner with agencies and vendors to ensure campaigns align with business objectives.
  • This role is both hands-on in-platform while collaborating closely with agency partners for scale, testing, and specialized execution.
  • Improving marketing efficiency through testing and ongoing optimization.

SEO & Website Optimization

  • Execute on-page, off-page, local, and technical SEO initiatives in partnership with internal stakeholders and external agencies.
  • Partner with technical and marketing teams on website enhancements and content development.
  • Manage local business listing updates, publish Google Business Profile content, and support online reputation management efforts.
  • Monitor and analyze website performance, identifying opportunities to improve user experience, conversion rates, and overall site effectiveness.
  • Support keyword research, landing page creation, A/B testing, and ongoing optimization efforts to drive organic traffic and lead generation.

Analytics & Reporting

  • Track and analyze digital marketing performance across channels.
  • Build reports and dashboards to communicate insights and recommendations.
  • Monitor KPIs including lead volume, cost per lead, conversion rates, organic traffic growth, and engagement metrics.
  • Translate performance data into actionable insights to inform ongoing optimization and testing.
  • Support monthly budget forecasting and vendor invoice reconciliation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Work closely with franchise marketing teams, creative partners, agencies, and web development partners.
  • Support local marketing initiatives and new salon opening campaigns.
  • Stay current on digital marketing trends, platform updates, and emerging opportunities.

Experience, Skills and Abilities:

  • 3–5+ years of hands on digital marketing experience.
  • Strong understanding of paid media platforms with an emphasis on Google Ads and Meta Ads.
  • Experience with SEO and website optimization best practices.
  • Proficiency with core ad platforms, Google Analytics, Looker Studio, Google Search Console.
  • Strong creative instincts and a knack for developing, testing, and optimizing high-performing ad content.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent communication and project management abilities.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or a related field.
  • Experience supporting franchise, multi-location, or local marketing environments.
  • Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation platforms.
  • Experience working with agencies or external partners.
  • Understanding of lead generation funnels and conversion optimization.
  • Beauty, wellness, retail, or lifestyle brand experience.

The salary range for this role is $70,000-$80,000 annually, commensurate on experience. This role is bonus-eligible and is based on company and individual performance; all bonuses are subject to board and CEO approval.

raw.description:
The Calix platform enables Communication Service Providers (CSPs) of all sizes to transform and future-proof their businesses. Through real-time data, automation, and actionable insights delivered via Calix One — our cloud-first, AI-powered platform — CSPs can simplify operations, collapse cost, and accelerate innovation. Calix One brings together the automation of everything and the experience of one, empowering customers to deliver differentiated subscriber experiences while driving acquisition, loyalty, and revenue growth. This is the Calix mission: to enable CSPs of all sizes to simplify, innovate, and grow, strengthening both their businesses and the communities they serve.

We’re at the forefront of a once in a generational change in the broadband industry. Join us as we innovate, help our customers reach their potential, and connect underserved communities with unrivaled digital experiences.

Role Overview

As a Staff Data Scientist focused on Calix Cloud and Intelligence, you will apply advanced analytics and machine learning to broadband access network, service, and subscriber telemetry data. You will work closely with senior data scientists, engineers, and product teams to build models and insights that power network intelligence, service assurance, and subscriber experience analytics within Calix’s cloud platforms.

Key Responsibilities

Calix Cloud - Analytics & AI

  • Analyze and model large-scale broadband telemetry and time-series data used by Calix cloud, including throughput, latency, packet loss, utilization, and device-level metrics, and many more.

  • Develop and validate ML models for Upsell, cross-sell, churn prevention, customer acquisition, anomaly detection, performance forecasting, fault classification, and capacity prediction that drive proactive network insights

  • Build features and models supporting network health scoring, service quality monitoring, and subscriber Quality of Experience (QoE) analytics

  • Apply advanced techniques such as time-series modeling, change-point detection, and probabilistic modeling to real-world broadband data

Calix Cloud - Platform & Scale

  • Collaborate with data engineering and platform teams to develop and integrate models into Calix Cloud’s cloud-native analytics pipelines

  • Perform EDA, feature engineering, and data preprocessing for scalable, production pipelines

  • Help scale analytics and ML solutions across millions of access devices, subscriber endpoints, and Wi-Fi environments

  • Design experiments and evaluate the business and operational impact of analytics on network performance and subscriber experience

  • Build scalable ML pipelines and deploy models into production environments.

Communication & Product Collaboration

  • Communicate insights clearly to product, engineering, and customer-facing teams via dashboards, reports, and presentations

  • Translate ambiguous product and operational problems into well-defined data science and ML solutions

  • Follow best practices in model lifecycle management, including versioning, validation, and deployment monitoring

Required Qualifications & Technical Skills

Education

  • PhD in Data Science or Computer Science is preferred

Data Science & Machine Learning

  • Strong foundation in statistics, probability, and linear algebra

  • Experience working with large-scale time-series and telemetry datasets typical of broadband analytics

  • Hands-on experience with ML techniques, including:

    • Regression and classification

    • Clustering and dimensionality reduction

    • Time-series analysis and forecasting

    • Anomaly detection and change-point detection

  • Experience with model evaluation, validation methods, and performance metrics

Programming & Data Analysis

  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with ML libraries NumPy, pandas, SciPy, scikit-learn

  • Strong SQL skills for large-scale data analysis

  • Ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code

  • Experience with data preprocessing, feature engineering, and exploratory data analysis (EDA)

Broadband / Network Data Fundamentals

  • Experience in analyzing broadband network and service telemetry

  • Ability to work with metrics such as latency, throughput, packet loss, utilization, and device-level signals

  • Understanding of noisy, incomplete, and delayed data common in broadband environments

  • Ability to reason about data across devices, subscribers, locations, and time windows

Analytical Thinking & Communication

  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to translate ambiguous product or network problems into analytical solutions

  • Clear written and verbal communication skills

  • Experience presenting insights through charts, dashboards, and reports

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience or research in broadband access networks, subscriber analytics, or network intelligence

  • Familiarity with Calix-relevant broadband technologies such as Fiber (PON), Cable (DOCSIS), and Wi-Fi telemetry

  • Experience with cloud-native data platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and ML deployment frameworks

  • Exposure to MLOps practices, including CI/CD, model monitoring, and lifecycle management

  • Knowledge of real-time analytics, streaming data, or large-scale data ecosystems

  • Publications or applied research in network analytics, anomaly detection, forecasting, or machine learning

raw.description:
About 2070 Health

2070 Health is India's first venture studio, established by W Health Ventures. It builds healthcare companies from scratch by identifying gaps in the market that remain unserved. Unlike an accelerator, the studio is directly involved in idea generation, daily operations, and strategic decisions as each company grows. Companies established in the last 24 months include Elevate Now, Nivaan Care, Reveal Healthtech, BabyMD, Everhope Oncology, and Everbright Health.

About the role

The Growth and Outreach role is responsible for running the studio's outbound engine end to end. This is not a standard SDR position. The role covers AI-assisted outreach across email and LinkedIn, with ownership of every component: data, sending infrastructure, copy, testing, and results.

This is a non-client-facing role. It builds and runs the outbound engine. Booked conversations and any client, customer, or investor relationships are handled by the research and investment teams, not by this role.

End-to-end experience required

This role requires hands-on experience across the entire outbound workflow. Candidates who have owned only individual parts of the process, with other functions or agencies handling the remainder, are not suited to this position. The workflow, owned end to end, includes the following.

  • Data sourcing. Building target lists from a defined ICP rather than inherited or purchased lists.
  • Data enrichment and hygiene. Verifying, deduplicating, and completing records.
  • Sending infrastructure. Setting up domains, mailboxes, warmup, and sending limits, whether directly or through a platform such as Instantly, with a clear understanding of how each functions.
  • Deliverability. Diagnosing and resolving bounces, spam placement, and declines in reply rates.
  • Copywriting. Producing cold emails that generate replies from a US audience, without reliance on mail-merge.
  • Campaign execution. Running multi-touch sequences across email and LinkedIn, including follow-ups.
  • Measurement and optimization. Tracking performance, running tests, and improving reply rates and meetings booked.

This experience must be current and hands-on, not drawn from a role held several years ago.

Scope of work

The role supports two use cases.

1. New thesis research and early sales. Working with the research team to test new company ideas in healthcare. This involves identifying the experts, clinicians, operators, and potential customers worth engaging, running outreach to book those conversations, and returning the resulting signal in a form the team can act on.

2. Fund outreach. Expanding the fund's relationships through researched, personalized outreach to downstream investors and potential LPs, including building and maintaining target lists, running sequences, and managing follow-up.

Working model

The role operates on a project basis. Deliverables and timelines are defined at the outset, after which the consultant sets priorities independently and reports progress on an agreed cadence. Performance is measured on outcomes rather than daily activity. The role does not include daily task assignment or supervision.

AI fluency

AI fluency is central to this role. The expectation is practical, demonstrated use rather than familiarity. Relevant capabilities include the following.

  • Researching accounts and personalizing outreach at scale using tools such as Claude, rather than generic templates.
  • Building AI steps into the pipeline, for example Clay AI columns or prompt chains, so that repetitive work is automated.
  • Connecting tools through light automation using Zapier, n8n, or custom scripts.
  • Evaluating new tools as they become available and retaining those that add value.
  • Primary tools: Apollo, Clay, Smartlead or Instantly, and a CRM such as HubSpot.

Requirements

Requirements

  • 5 to 7 years of experience, the majority in hands-on cold outreach that booked meetings, with campaigns run directly by the candidate.
  • A record of owning a metric such as reply rate, meetings booked, or pipeline, with accountability for the outcome rather than task completion.
  • Direct experience at an early-stage company where outreach was owned as a sole function. Additional experience at a larger, more structured organization is an advantage, as it indicates exposure to outreach at scale.
  • Experience running outreach to US prospects, with the ability to write for that audience.
  • Strong written English, producing cold emails that read as though written by a person.
  • The ability to learn quickly, given limited ramp-up time.
  • Healthcare experience is an advantage but not a requirement.

This role is not a fit if

  • Campaign experience is limited to data, sending infrastructure, and copy prepared by others.
  • Daily direction and task management are required to remain productive.
  • Outreach experience is several years old and has since given way to a management role rather than direct execution.
  • Only parts of the workflow described above have been performed, with the remainder to be learned on the job.
  • Experience comes from a large organization in which separate teams owned each stage of the process and only one stage was owned directly.

Company Overview:Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody. Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Role Summary

The Provider Support Coordinator supports the Practice Access Management (PAM) team at the intersection of data quality and provider engagement. This role is equally operational and customer-facing: Provider Support Coordinators execute data and administrative workflows in Salesforce in addition to conducting structured outbound outreach to provider offices on behalf of BlinkRx.

PSCs are often the first point of contact a provider office has with BlinkRx, and play a critical role in establishing the foundation for PAM-led growth. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented and process-driven, with strong communication skills and confidence engaging professionally with provider offices.

Responsibilities

Data Quality & Account Management

  • Create, update, and maintain provider accounts and contacts in Salesforce following standardized processes to keep practice records accurate and complete.
  • Clean up records by fixing duplicate accounts and contacts, correcting associations, reassigning holding-account contacts, and ensuring proper account hierarchy.
  • Complete and validate required account and contact fields so downstream workflows and automation function as expected.
  • Monitor automated workflows and alerts; investigate and resolve issues flagged by systems or the PAM team.
  • Flag recurring issues, data inconsistencies, or process gaps and share them with the appropriate partners for follow-up.

Provider Engagement & Outreach

  • Make outbound calls to provider offices to support marketing opt-ins, confirm communication consent, and verify key practice and contact details.
  • Conduct introductory outreach to new accounts — introduce BlinkRx, gather key office and workflow information needed for PA processes, and lay the groundwork for PAM-led growth efforts.
  • Recognize when a provider shows interest or requires follow-up during outreach and document relevant context.
  • Ensure clear, timely handoffs to the PAM team with accurate notes to support successful engagement.
  • Reach out to existing accounts at key points in the relationship lifecycle to surface growth opportunities and keep account data current ahead of PAM follow-up.
  • Triage and resolve inbound requests from the pharmacy team that require direct outreach to HCP offices.

Qualifications

Required

  • 1–3 years of experience in operations, administrative support, data entry, or sales operations
  • Strong attention to detail and data accuracy
  • Experience with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred)
  • Excellent communication skills; comfortable conducting efficient, professional outreach with provider offices
  • Strong organizational and multitasking ability

Preferred

  • Healthcare operations or provider data experience
  • Familiarity with Salesforce

Why Join Us:It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population. At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year. Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

Job Family Group:

Research & Technology Group

Job Description:

Wer wir sind:

Als eine der weltweit führenden Schmierstoffmarken kann Castrol auf eine lange Tradition der Innovation und Unterstützung von Wegbereitenden zurückblicken. Dank unserer Leidenschaft für Höchstleistung und einer schon immer stark auf Kooperation und Partnerschaft ausgerichteten Philosophie konnte Castrol Schmierstoffe und Fette entwickeln, die seit mehr als 125 Jahren für die Mobilität an Land, auf dem Wasser, in der Luft und im Weltraum führend sind. 

Heute verfolgt Castrolauch das Ziel stärkerer Nachhaltigkeit durch Abfallreduzierung und Senkung der CO2-Emissionen im Lebenszyklus von Castrol Produkten. Castrol ist Teil von bp und bietet Produkte und Dienstleistungen für Kund: innen und Verbraucher: innen in den Branchen Automobil, Marine, Industrie und Energie. Unsere Markenprodukte stehen weltweit für Innovation, Technologieführerschaft, Leistungsstärke und ein kompromissloses Bekenntnis zur Qualität. 

Wie Du die Zukunft mitgestalten kannst:

Als Technical Engineer (m/w/d) unterstützt Du unsere Kunden und Vertriebsteams mit fundierter technischer Expertise rund um industrielle Schmierstoffe und deren Anwendungen. Mit Deinem Fachwissen entwickelst Du gemeinsam mit Kunden und internen Stakeholdern innovative Lösungen, schaffst nachhaltigen Mehrwert und trägst aktiv zum Geschäftserfolg von Castrol bei.

  • Fachliche Unterstützung interner und externer Stakeholder als Experte für industrielle Schmierstoffanwendungen

  • Unterstützung der Vertriebsteams bei der Gewinnung von Neugeschäft und beim Ausbau bestehender Kundenbeziehungen

  • Entwicklung wirtschaftlicher und praxisnaher Lösungen für komplexe Kundenanforderungen gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb

  • Konzeption und Durchführung technischer Schulungen für interne und externe Stakeholder

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Technology und Marketing zur Weiterentwicklung von Produkten und Services

  • Dokumentation und Weitergabe von Best Practices sowie Erstellung technischer Fallstudien

  • Analyse und Bewertung von Gebrauchtölanalysen zur Unterstützung technischer Entscheidungen

  • Unterstützung strategischer Projekte zur Umsetzung der Castrol Industriestrategie

  • Fachliche Begleitung und Weiterentwicklung weniger erfahrener Kolleg:innen durch Mentoring und Coaching

  • Repräsentation von Castrol in technischen Netzwerken, Verbänden, Arbeitsgruppen und bei Bedarf an Universitäten

Dein Qualifikationsprofil – fundiert und aus Leidenschaft:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Ingenieurwesen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, beispielsweise in Maschinenbau, Chemieingenieurwesen, Schmierstofftechnik, Fertigungstechnik oder einem verwandten Fachgebiet

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung in einem industriellen Umfeld

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich Metallbearbeitungsflüssigkeiten und Hochleistungsschmierstoffe sowie deren Anwendung

  • Gutes Verständnis der Tribologie und der technischen Grundlagen von Schmierstoffen

  • Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten in der technischen Kundenberatung und im Value Selling

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit Microsoft Office, CRM-Systemen wie Salesforce sowie weiteren relevanten Tools

  • Strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise bei komplexen technischen Fragestellungen

  • Kenntnisse im Bereich Nachhaltigkeit, Energieeffizienz und Ressourcenschonung sind von Vorteil

  • Hohe Kommunikationsfähigkeit und sicheres Auftreten gegenüber Kunden und internen Stakeholdern

Work-Life Balance und was sonst noch für uns spricht:

  • Team Spirit: Events und gemeinsamer Spaß.

  • Doppelt Gutes tun: Spenden werden verdoppelt.

Wir engagieren uns für Gleichstellung, Diversität sowie die Vereinbarkeit von Beruf und Familie. Menschen mit einer Schwerbehinderung werden bei entsprechender Eignung vorrangig eingestellt.

Diese Rolle gehört zu Castrol. Du wirst im Vorfeld der geplanten Veräußerung von Castrol im Jahr 2026 Teil des Castrol-Ringfences. Nach dem Vollzug der Veräußerung wirst Du vollständig bei Castrol beschäftigt sein und nicht länger Mitarbeiter von bp sein.

raw.description:
As a global leader in cybersecurity, CrowdStrike protects the people, processes and technologies that drive modern organizations. Since 2011, our mission hasn’t changed — we’re here to stop breaches, and we’ve redefined modern security with the world’s most advanced AI-native platform. We work on large scale distributed systems, processing almost 3 trillion events per day and this traffic is growing daily. Our customers span all industries, and they count on CrowdStrike to keep their businesses running, their communities safe and their lives moving forward. We're proud to work for a mission-driven company leveraging AI to transform the way we work. CrowdStrikers drive their careers through flexibility and autonomy while also being expected to contribute to a culture of responsible AI adoption, experimentation, and innovation. We use an AI-first mindset as a force multiplier to proactively and continuously accelerate execution, build expertise, uncover insights, and solve complex problems. We’re always looking to add talented CrowdStrikers to the team who have limitless passion, a relentless focus on innovation and a fanatical commitment to our customers, our community and each other. Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:

The Red Team Consultant will perform dedicated Red Team activities simulating known threat actors, to help CrowdStrike customers determine the impact and likelihood of threat actors to accomplish objectives across the Kill Chain and MITRE ATT&CK Framework. The Red Team Consultant is expected to be able to coordinate with senior leadership, plan, execute assessments and assist the other CrowdStrike Services’ functions to help improve customers' security defense.

What You’ll Do:

  • Perform penetration assessments of operating systems, applications, databases and network infrastructure components to detect, enumerate threats.

  • Produce high-quality written and verbal reports, presentations, security-focused recommendations, and factual findings of results of Red Team activities to customer management.

  • Must be able to effectively communicate at all levels (executive leadership and technical support teams) within CrowdStrike.

  • Be a team player and lead/assist in developing and improving an information security program and information security resources.

  • Provide guidance using specialized knowledge and toolsets to operational teams during enterprise wide crisis scenarios, e.g. large-scale production service outages, outside of the routine change management process.

  • Must be able to work as an technical operator on various types of penetration testing offerings with an OPSEC mindset.

What You’ll Need:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in a Red Team/Penetration Testing activities is highly preferred.

  • Security community participation (conference speaker, tool development contributor etc.) is highly preferred.

  • Advanced experience with security assessment tools (Metasploit, NMAP, Cobalt Strike, Nessus, Burp Suite, etc.).

  • Comprehensive understanding of the security methodologies, technologies, and best practices.

  • Windows / Linux / UNIX / Mac operating systems.

  • Advanced experience with Networking components (routers, switches, load balancers, wireless access points, etc.).

  • Comprehensive knowledge of firewalls, proxies, mail servers and web servers.

  • Advanced experience with operational support for operating systems, applications and networks.

  • Advanced experience with Red Teaming (vulnerability/penetration testing/adversary emulation assessments).

  • Advanced experience in automation and scripting of applications and systems.

  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

  • Desirable Certifications: OSCP, GPEN, OSCE, GCIH, GXPN.

  • Occasional travel may be required (<25%).

This role may require the candidate to periodically undergo and pass alcohol and/or drug test(s) during the course of employment.

  • Competitive vacation and holidays for recharge

  • Professional development opportunities for all employees regardless of level or role

  • Vibrant office culture with world class amenities

  • Great Place to Work Certified™ across the globe

Zevo Health is a global leader committed to supporting the mental well-being of content moderators and Trust & Safety professionals. As we expand, we’re seeking passionate and qualified affiliates to join our team.
In this role, you'll provide one-to-one digital therapy through video consultations. You’ll use evidence-based practices such as CBT, ACT, and SFBT to support clients in managing the unique psychological challenges they face in their work environments. You'll be an integral part of helping professionals in the online content industry build resilience and cope with stress.

  • Assess and manage clinical risks, ensuring the well-being of clients.

  • Maintain clear and timely communication with the clinical team.

Experience & Qualifications Required

  • Doctoral degree (PhD or PsyD) in Clinical Psychology
  • Active, unrestricted PSYPACT licence to deliver telepsychology services across multiple states.
  • Minimum 3 years of clinical experience.
  • Additional training in short-term, solution-focused therapy is a plus.
  • Certification in suicide risk assessment (e.g., SafeTALK, ASIST) desired.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office and video conferencing tools.
  • Fluent in English (written and spoken).
  • Strong data management and administrative skills.
  • Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-paced, evolving environment.

raw.description:
Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

As a Customer Success Manager, you’ll play a critical role in helping customers get long-term value from CompanyCam. In this individual contributor role, you’ll act as a trusted partner to a portfolio of customers, guiding them through adoption, renewal, and growth. Through proactive outreach and meaningful conversations, you’ll help customers solve real problems while ensuring they fully understand how CompanyCam supports their business goals. This role is essential to reducing churn, increasing engagement, and driving expansion across our customer base. You’ll work closely with Sales, Marketing, and Product to ensure our customers feel supported at every stage of their journey.

Location: Candidates must permanently and currently reside in the United States.

What You'll Do

  • Proactively engage with customers to monitor account health and drive successful adoption
  • Educate and train customers on CompanyCam features, best practices, and new product updates
  • Identify at-risk accounts and execute thoughtful retention strategies to reduce churn and downgrades
  • Manage renewals by guiding customers through contract continuation and addressing concerns
  • Partner with Account Managers to identify and qualify growth opportunities such as add-ons or expanded usage
  • Advocate for customer needs internally while aligning with CompanyCam’s business goals
  • Develop and contribute to training resources that improve customer education and product usage

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

  • Improving customer retention by proactively addressing risk and strengthening relationships
  • Increasing product engagement and revenue through education, adoption, and expansion efforts
  • Elevating the customer voice across the organization to influence better outcomes and experiences
  • Showcasing customer success to help others understand the value of growing with CompanyCam

What You'll Bring

  • Experience in a customer-facing role, ideally within a SaaS environment
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to lead quality customer conversations
  • Proven ability to work independently while managing a book of business
  • A high level of empathy and a customer-first mindset balanced with business goals
  • Strong problem-solving and strategic thinking skills
  • Ability to identify trends and opportunities through customer usage and feedback
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or Communications, preferred
  • A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
  • A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary is $48,000 per year. Our average on target earnings (OTE) are around $67,200. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

Note: Resumes sent to this email will not be reviewed or responded to. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

raw.description:
Ready to make a difference?

We are seeking a Senior Transmission Line Engineer to support and advance our growing transmission engineering practice. In this role, you will provide senior‑level technical expertise, lead complex design and analysis work, mentor junior engineers, and ensure high‑quality deliverables across a wide range of transmission line engineering projects for utility clients.

Our team is passionate about re‑engineering the way electric utilities solve their toughest challenges. We combine innovation, technical rigor, and a client‑first mindset to deliver exceptional engineering solutions—from detailed design to advanced modeling and analysis.

Why you’ll love working here:

  • Quality of life: Fully remote, flexible schedule, work-life balance

  • Investment of the community: Donation matching, volunteer opportunities

  • Investment in you: Tuition reimbursement, access to professional development resources, 401k matching, Employee Stock Purchase Plan

  • And many, many more (Ask your recruiter for more details!)

The Ideal Candidate

  • Highly motivated engineering leader who takes pride in delivering exceptional services and ensuring projects are completed accurately and on schedule

  • Proactive team leader who understands how to motivate, direct, and manage the work of others

  • Strong communicator who effectively defines and prioritizes group objectives, trains and mentors individually and collectively, and contributes to a positive team dynamic

  • Demonstrates initiative, self-sufficiency, and the ability to work productively from a home office without direct supervision

  • Committed to continuous learning and process improvement, consistently seeking opportunities to enhance quality and efficiency

  • Embraces new responsibilities and eagerly acquires new skill sets as needed to support evolving project and industry demands.

What you will be doing:

  • Lead and oversee complex transmission line designs from conceptual engineering through final design, including EFM, conductor sizing, induction, impedance, losses, and voltage drop analysis.

  • Provide senior‑level technical expertise and direction to design staff, ensuring technical accuracy, best practices, and industry‑leading design solutions.

  • Perform key engineering studies such as conductor economic evaluations, lightning performance, grounding calculations, and electrical clearance determinations per NESC and applicable standards.

  • Interpret and apply regulatory requirements including NERC, FERC, and regional standards, and ensure compliance across project deliverables.

  • Prepare and review technical documentation such as specifications, data sheets, RFQs, bid evaluations, vendor drawings, and purchase recommendations.

  • Collaborate with project managers on scopes, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, construction support, and change order management.

  • Perform and review QA/QC for engineering deliverables, production drawings, CAD outputs, and construction administration activities, resolving design‑related field issues.

  • Conduct and lead field inspections, measurements, calculations, and installation reviews for both public and private clients.

  • Develop and present technical reports, support marketing and business development efforts, and build strong relationships with clients and contractors.

  • Provide mentorship, leadership, and guidance to less experienced engineers, ensuring effective cross‑discipline communication and adherence to company safety, quality, and performance standards.

What you need to have (minimum qualifications):

  • B.S. in Electrical, Civil, Mechanical, or Power Engineering (or related field)

What we would like you to have (preferred qualifications):

  • 8+ years of transmission line engineering experience (design, analysis, modeling, or similar)

  • 8+ years of experience working with an electric utility, EPC, or engineering consulting firm

  • 8+ years of experience working in PLS‑CADD

  • People management and mentorship experience

  • Experience directing and reviewing the work of others for quality assurance and delivering constructive feedback

  • Knowledge of the practical application of industry standards such as: NESC, IEEE, ANSI, FERC‑881, and FAC‑008 standards

  • Ability to plan and manage assignments and clearly communicate barriers to complete tasks on budget/schedule

  • Initiative to embrace continuous learning toward becoming an expert on the programs and services you represent
