Leidos' EPC Solutions Team is seeking a Director of Project Management. This role require previous experience managing engineering and EPC project portfolios within the electric utility industry. The Director of Project Management is a senior leadership position responsible for leading a team of Project Managers delivering complex engineering services for transmission, substation, distribution, and system planning projects across North America. This role provides strategic leadership for the successful execution of a portfolio of engineering projects performed primarily as a subcontractor to construction-led EPC prime contractors and directly for electric utility clients.

Reporting to Leidos EPC leadership, the Director partners closely with Regional Leadership, Engineering Directors, Operations, Project Controls, and Business Development to ensure safe, predictable, and profitable execution of projects while developing a high-performing project management organization.

The successful candidate will have demonstrated experience leading project management organizations, overseeing large multi-project portfolios, developing project managers, managing commercial risk, and building trusted executive relationships with utility clients and EPC partners. This individual will play a critical role in driving operational excellence, financial performance, organizational growth, and strategic initiatives across the business.

Project Portfolio Leadership

  • Lead a team of Project Managers responsible for delivering a portfolio of complex transmission, substation, distribution, and system planning engineering projects for alternative delivery projects serving contractors, developers, and investor-owned and public utilities.
  • Provide executive oversight of engineering execution for projects delivered under EPC, Progressive Design-Build, and Engineering Services contracts.
  • Drive consistent project execution practices that improve safety, quality, schedule performance, client satisfaction, and profitability.
  • Establish governance processes that enable early identification and resolution of project risks, scope changes, resource constraints, and commercial issues.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to ensure technical execution aligns with contractual obligations, construction sequencing, and client expectations.
  • Provide executive-level decision making for critical project issues requiring cross-functional coordination.

EPC Project Execution

  • Lead engineering project execution supporting construction-led EPC prime contractors on large capital infrastructure projects.
  • Ensure engineering deliverables support procurement, construction sequencing, commissioning, and overall EPC project milestones.
  • Develop strategies to mitigate engineering-related schedule impacts while maintaining quality and contractual compliance.
  • Partner with Construction, Procurement, and Project Controls organizations to proactively manage engineering interfaces throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Lead resolution of engineering changes, field issues, RFIs, and construction support activities.

Commercial and Financial Management

  • Maintain overall responsibility for the financial performance of a portfolio of engineering projects including revenue, gross margin, utilization, backlog, forecasting, and cash flow.
  • Lead project managers in managing contract scope, commercial risk, change orders, and claims avoidance.
  • Review project forecasts and financial performance to identify trends and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure consistent application of project controls, earned value principles, forecasting methodologies, and PMO governance.
  • Participate in contract negotiations and executive commercial discussions with clients and EPC partners.

Organizational Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Project Managers, Project Controls professionals, and Project Coordinators.
  • Establish performance expectations and provide ongoing coaching, performance management, and career development.
  • Build organizational capability through training, succession planning, and leadership development.
  • Drive accountability for project execution, financial performance, client satisfaction, and employee engagement.
  • Foster collaboration across Engineering, Operations, Project Controls, Business Development, and Executive Leadership.

Program Performance

  • Monitor project health across multiple programs and implement portfolio recovery strategies where necessary.
  • Lead executive project reviews.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives throughout the PMO.
  • Standardize project management tools, procedures, governance, and reporting.

Resource Planning

  • Lead strategic workforce planning across multiple project portfolios.
  • Partner with Engineering leadership to optimize resource utilization and staffing.
  • Forecast future staffing requirements and support recruiting efforts for Project Management personnel.
  • Balance workload across programs to maximize utilization and project performance.

Business Development

  • Develop long-term strategic relationships with utility clients and EPC partners.
  • Support account management activities and identify opportunities for portfolio expansion.
  • Develop capture strategies that differentiate the company based on technical expertise, execution approach, schedule, commercial strategy, and client value.
  • Evaluate competitive positioning, client drivers, procurement strategies, and project risks to develop winning pursuit strategies.
  • Participate in capture planning, proposal strategy, pricing reviews, and executive presentations.
  • Present pursuit strategies, pricing recommendations, commercial assumptions, and risk assessments to executive leadership during bid approval and investment review meetings.
  • Recommend bid/no-bid decisions based on strategic alignment, resource availability, commercial risk, and financial objectives.
  • Support contract negotiations to ensure scope, commercial terms, risk allocation, and execution expectations align with company objectives.
  • Collaborate with Business Development to expand existing accounts and enter new markets.
  • Represent the company at industry conferences and client meetings

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business, or related field.
  • 12+ years of progressive experience managing engineering and EPC project portfolios within the electric utility industry.
  • 7+ years leading Project Managers or project management organizations.
  • Demonstrated success managing engineering services provided under EPC, Design-Build, or Engineering Services contracts.
  • Experience supporting engineering organizations serving as subcontractors to construction-led EPC prime contractors is highly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of EPC project lifecycle including engineering, procurement, construction, commissioning, and project closeout.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multimillion-dollar project portfolios with full financial accountability.
  • Proven experience negotiating scope changes, managing commercial risk, and improving project profitability.
  • Experience developing PMO processes, governance, and organizational standards.
  • Strong understanding of project controls, forecasting, earned value management, and portfolio reporting.
  • PMP certification preferred.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred.

Professional Attributes that will help you succeed in this role:

  • Executive presence with exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Proven ability to lead through influence across matrix organizations.
  • Strategic thinker capable of balancing client needs, operational priorities, and financial objectives.
  • Strong commercial acumen with the ability to make sound business decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead organizational change and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Excellent conflict resolution, negotiation, and executive presentation skills.
  • High emotional intelligence with a passion for mentoring and developing future leaders.

Your Background

  • Outbound sales — cold calling, SDR/BDR with a track record of booking and closing, field sales, door-to-door, telesales
  • B2C closing — insurance, real estate, financial products, automotive, telecom, retail finance. You closed deals face-to-face or over the phone, and you hit numbers.
  • BPO sales — outbound or upselling roles at a call center with U.S. client exposure
  • SDR/BDR promoted to AE — you've already made the jump, or you're ready to make it now
  • Any sales role where rejection was part of the job and you showed up anyway

What We Need From You
  • English at C1 or C2 — clear, confident, natural with U.S. buyers
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding targets — any industry, B2B or B2C
  • CRM discipline — HubSpot or equivalent
  • Available Monday–Friday during US Eastern or Central hours
  • Stable home internet (min. 40 Mbps) for daily video calls
  • Mindset: Hungry · Gritty · Coachable · Accountable

This Role Is NOT For You If: You wait for a manager to tell you what to do each day. You treat "not now" as a dead end. You blame leads or tools when numbers fall short. You see CRM hygiene as optional admin work.

What's in it for you

Your Offer
  • Guaranteed Base - $1,500 – $2,500 monthly foundation for stability
  • Performance Commission - 15–25%, increasing with performance excellence
  • Average Commission Reality - $1,500 – $2,000 monthly (what most AEs earn)
  • Total Monthly Earnings - $2,500 – $4,500+ with a clear path to increase
  • Truly Uncapped Commission - Our top performers consistently earn $5,000+ monthly
  • Employment Type - Independent Contractor/Consultant – Full-Time
  • Workplace Type - Fully Remote
  • Reporting To - Inbound Sales Manager

Your Growth Path
  • Account Executive (0–6 months): Master Magic’s product suite, build pipeline discipline, establish consultative selling habits
  • Senior Account Executive (6–18 months): Consistently exceed quota, mentor new AEs, manage higher-value accounts
  • Team Lead / Sales Manager (18–36 months): Lead a pod of AEs, own team targets, contribute to sales strategy
  • Sales Director (3+ years): Oversee sales operations, drive go-to-market strategy, partner with leadership on growth

Key Time Zone Schedule Requirements
  • Work Schedule: 9-hour shifts following US business hours
  • Paid Training Schedule: 9:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time (mandatory attendance for 5 weeks)
  • Time Zone Alignment: Must be able to consistently work in Eastern Time, including adjustments for Daylight Saving Time and other US time zones
  • Availability: Monday to Friday, with consistent availability during U.S. business hours

Equipment Requirements (Self-Provided)
  • Computer/laptop meeting company specifications
  • Reliable high-speed internet connection (minimum 50 Mbps download / 10 Mbps upload)
  • Professional headset for clear client communication
  • Quiet, distraction-free work environment—all calls and interviews must be conducted from a professional, stationary setup (not while walking or commuting)

“World-class Human Resources" are more than just pretty words here; it is our singular goal. A goal we are making remarkable progress on, and one we hope to achieve with your help.

What will I be doing in this role?

The Senior Compensation Analyst provides complex compensation consultative services to Human Resources and leadership for assigned areas, including job evaluation and competitive pay analysis. This role designs and implements compensation solutions, programs, and initiatives that support organizational objectives through strong communication, collaboration, and influence. The Senior Compensation Analyst manages projects impacting areas of responsibility and oversees key aspects of major compensation initiatives and programs while providing data-driven recommendations to support informed decision-making.

  • Conduct benchmarking, market research, and statistical analyses to develop compensation recommendations that support competitive, cost-effective, and legally compliant pay practices.
  • Consult with assigned client groups to provide guidance on compensation policies and programs, including evaluation of requests for changes and updates.

  • Manage and administer compensation projects and programs, including design, communication, implementation, and ongoing updates.
  • Identify process improvement opportunities and support the implementation of compensation best practices.
  • Prepare complex costing analyses, ad hoc reports, and other compensation-related reporting.
  • Participate in the development and administration of the organization’s annual wage planning process.
  • Monitor labor market trends and recommend updates to salary structures and pay practices to maintain market competitiveness.
  • Maintain and audit compensation-related data in the HR system, including job codes, salary plans, grades, and shift differentials.
  • Provide compensation guidance, training, and regulatory updates to HR and leadership.
  • Serve as a resource to HR, Compensation, and organizational staff regarding compensation policies, procedures, and related practices.
  • Partner with Human Resources, Payroll, and organizational leadership to address complex operational issues and support compensation-related changes, including mass pay and job updates.
  • Ensure compensation practices remain compliant with federal, state, and local regulations.

raw.title: People Operations and Systems Specialist
raw.excerpt: Who is Spring Fertility? We are a passionate, dedicated team of leading physicians and scientists who have trained at some of the world’s top research hospitals and fertility centers.
raw.description:
Who is Spring Fertility?

We are a passionate, dedicated team of leading physicians and scientists who have trained at some of the world’s top research hospitals and fertility centers. Together, we are building the fastest-growing fertility group in the country, grounded in clinical excellence and innovation. We deliver deeply patient-centric, individualized, and compassionate care, recognizing that every journey is unique. Our mission is to partner with patients to help them achieve their goals, whatever those may be. We believe everyone deserves the opportunity to build a family if they choose, and our team is committed to guiding and supporting patients every step of the way.

Why should you join our team?

We are a mission-driven organization seeking motivated, high-performing professionals who are eager to innovate and make an impact. As we build a first-class fertility practice, we balance excellence with a culture that values collaboration, positivity, and enjoyment in the work we do. We are growing rapidly and are deeply committed to the professional and personal development of our team. Guided by optimism, compassion, and teamwork, we are united by a shared dedication to putting patients first.

Role Summary

As the People Operations + Systems Specialist, you will support the consistent, accurate, and employee-centered delivery of core People Team processes across the global employee life cycle. Embracing One Team, One Mission, you will partner seamlessly across the People Team to execute administrative workflows, manage employee transactions, and deliver a best-in-class employee experience.

In this role, you will champion data integrity and systems' accuracy, support benefits and leave processes, and maintain compliance. Driven to Learn, Improve, Evolve, you will leverage high standards and data to continuously optimize processes, driving scalable, seamless operations in a fast-paced environment.

People Business Partner Support

  • Maintain strong knowledge of multistate employment law and legislation in the states we operate in.
  • Monitor and respond to employee inquiries received through shared People Team inboxes, ensuring timely responses, accurate documentation notes, appropriate routing and consistent employee experience
  • Support routine policy and process interpretation, escalating complex or high-risk matters to People Partners, Legal, Benefits or other subject matter experts as appropriate.
  • Maintain and improve process documentation, department forms, job aids, and internal knowledge base content to support scalable People Ops delivery.
  • Own assigned portions of the offboarding workflow in partnership with the People Business Partners, ensuring timely, compliant and accurate execution of both voluntary and involuntary separations.
  • Own timely administrative processing of Employee Change Forms and Verifications of Employment
  • Maintain accurate employee records throughout the employee lifecycle, ensuring audit-ready documentation practices.
  • Provide support to People Business Partners In coordinating routine Leaves of Absence and Accommodation process steps, ensuring documentation, routing and follow-up are handled consistently and confidentially.
  • Support People Ops projects and cross-functional initiatives as needed.

People Operations & Systems

  • Ensure work and tasks completed within HRIS system are maintained with accuracy and integrity.
  • Troubleshoot HRIS-related issues and partner with internal team and external vendors to resolve discrepancies
  • Fulfill simple reporting requests and support recurring People Ops reporting needs with attention to data accuracy and confidentiality
  • Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve workflows, and increase consistency through better use of systems, documentation, automation, and AI.
  • Analyze employee inquiry trends and recommend improvements to documentation, training materials, workflows, and self-service content.

Benefits Administration

  • Process employee benefits transactions in HRIS including new hire enrollments and life events, and collect required documentation from employees as applicable
  • Support annual open enrollment activities, employee communications, and issue resolution in partnership with People Team and benefit Brokers
  • Support for employee benefit inquiries and provide general guidance on available plans, programs, and processes.
  • Coordinate with benefits vendors to resolve employee issues and ensure timely follow-up.

Education, Licenses, Certifications

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Exceptional Communication Skills
  • Service Oriented
  • 3+ years of directly related experience
  • Project management skills

Employment Type

This is a full-time non-exempt remote position based in one of our regions that requires flexibility to different time zones

Compensation

The starting salary range for this role is $30-35/hr. Salary is based on several factors including job related knowledge and skill set, depth of experience, certifications and/or degrees.

Benefits

Investing in You Today and Tomorrow

Supporting your well-being

  • Competitive medical, dental, and vision plans

  • Paid time off to recharge and enjoy personal time

  • Access to BetterHelp therapy sessions for mental and emotional wellness

  • Commuter benefits and discounted rates on home, auto, and pet insurance

Investing in your future

  • 401(k) with up to a 4% company match

  • Comprehensive fertility and parental leave benefits

  • Career development opportunities in a fast-growing organization

  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance

*Temporary and contract roles may not be eligible for all benefits listed above

Don’t have it all? We still welcome you to apply!

At Spring Fertility, we believe that everyone who wants a family deserves to have one, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, race, ethnicity, or religion. Just as we acknowledge and value the diversity of goals, life experiences, and unique paths to parenthood among our patients, we also actively celebrate diversity within our organization. We are an equal opportunity employer, and we are committed to a safe and inclusive work environment for all. We recognize that diversity among our team allows us to not only more effectively serve our patients, but also to advance innovation and opportunity within our field. We encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to apply to our employment opportunities.

We are scientists. We are humanists. We are passionate about fertility.

Spring Fertility will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please give us a call.

raw.excerpt: Join Sandbox Interactive and support the vibrant Albion Online player community as a Freelance Support Agent.
raw.description:
Join Sandbox Interactive and support the vibrant Albion Online player community as a Freelance Support Agent. We're looking for proactive, empathetic, and tech-savvy individuals fluent in Italian (or any other languages) to help players experience the best of our award-winning MMO across all platforms. Operate within a passionate, international team committed to high-quality service and player satisfaction.

About Sandbox Interactive and Albion Online

Sandbox Interactive is the independent studio behind Albion Online, the first truly cross-platform MMO available for Windows, Mac, Linux, iOS, and Android. With over 350,000 daily players, we’ve built a thriving, global gaming environment. You’ll become part of an international team based in Berlin, working to make Albion Online an unforgettable experience for players worldwide.

Main Responsibilities

  • Provide fast, friendly, and effective support to players via our ticketing platform, as well as potentially through chat and email

  • Resolve technical, account, and gameplay queries with empathy and professionalism

  • Escalate complex issues and collaborate with internal teams to ensure thorough resolution

  • Identify and report recurring player issues, suggesting improvements to enhance the player experience

  • Maintain up-to-date knowledge of Albion Online and its systems, staying informed about game updates and community trends

  • Deliver support in a clear, concise, and respectful manner, ensuring player confidentiality and satisfaction

Key Requirements

  • Fluency in written and spoken Italian

  • Solid verbal and written English communication skills for effective internal collaboration and external communication

  • Flexible availability to cover shifts, including evenings and weekends (remote/freelance)

  • Demonstrated empathy, patience, and excellent problem-solving skills

  • Comfortable using digital tools (ticketing platforms, spreadsheets, basic troubleshooting)

  • Deep interest in online games and a genuine desire to help the player community

Additional Information

  • This is a freelance, remote, part-time position

  • All applicants must be 18+ and able to receive international payments

  • Applications must be submitted in English

  • If you’re fluent in any additional languages, we’d be happy to hear from you.

Ready to Support Albion Online's Community?

If you’re passionate about games, fluent in Italian or another language, and motivated to provide a great player experience, we’d be happy to hear from you.

raw.description:
About the Founder Institute:

The Founder Institute (FI) is the world's largest pre-seed startup accelerator. We’ve helped launch over 6,500 companies in 200+ cities globally, which have raised in total over $1.75BN of funding.

We’re looking for a Global Marketing Operations Manager with a love for startups to join our team. We are based in Silicon Valley and have remote team members across Colorado, New York, Pennsylvania, Bulgaria, India, the U.K, and Brazil. Our success has been documented in the New York Times, BusinessWeek, Forbes, TechCrunch,and more.

You will have the opportunity to see entrepreneurship from every angle and work for a company whose mission is to empower entrepreneurs across the globe.

About the Role:

The Global Marketing Operations Manager will report to the Head of Growth and will:

What will you do?

  • Develop local marketing plans, frameworks, and best-practices that can be repeated across multiple FI accelerators worldwide
  • Interact with Local Leaders and Account Managers to troubleshoot marketing issues, collect feedback, run experiments, and spearhead new projects
  • Train Local Leaders on our latest findings and best practices, maintain internal guides and resources, and develop ways to ensure this information is always at their fingertips
  • Continuously strive to make local marketing easier by streamlining complex processes and documentation
  • Assist in the promotion of local accelerators via content, email, social media, public relations, and inbound-marketing techniques
  • Coordinate day-to-day marketing activities, and assist in the production of marketing assets, copy, and campaigns
  • And much more - at FI everyone wears a number of different hats and is expected to be a self-starter!

What are we looking for?

  • Native or business-fluent in English
  • Excellent writing/ copywriting skills
  • Excellent verbal communication skills (client management or sales experience a HUGE plus)
  • Experience working in startups and/or venture capital, with a deep understanding of accelerators and the startup community
  • Experience and knowledge of content marketing, email marketing, social media marketing, and public relations best practices
  • Exceptional attention to detail, autonomous time management
  • Experience in the startup/ entrepreneurship or venture capital industry
  • Intrinsic desire for learning, experimentation, and career advancement
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and sometimes stressful environment

What We Offer:

  • An opportunity to work with a global company and learn about the world through the lens of entrepreneurship
  • Great opportunity for growth within a small, energetic team of ~25 remote employees
  • Competitive compensation package commensurate with experience
  • Flexible working schedule with remote work and access to a coworking space.

This position is virtual, will require the candidate to work Monday-Friday, and will report to the Head of Growth.

Salary Range: Commensurate with experience

To get the best candidate experience, please consider applying for a maximum of 3 roles within 12 months to ensure you are not duplicating efforts.

Job Category

Marketing & Communications

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 Agentic CRM, helping companies become Agentic Enterprises where humans and AI agents drive customer success together. Our trusted platform unifies people, agents, apps, and data so work happens with shared context, governed execution, and continuous intelligence — boosting productivity and deepening every customer relationship.

This Role

We are looking for an exceptional storyteller and product marketing leader to join our dynamic Agentforce Sales team. As our Portfolio Storytelling & Keynote lead, you are the author of our overarching narrative—responsible for building the story of Agentforce Sales and ensuring it lands with conviction on every stage, in every channel, and through every voice. You translate complex product innovation into stories that are human, memorable, and easy to believe in. You build narratives that executives can own and deliver with confidence, that customers can see themselves in, and that analysts and influencers want to amplify. This role demands deep product fluency, creative boldness, and the instinct to know which story to tell - and how to make others tell it just as well.

A significant and exciting aspect of this role is owning our major keynote presentations. You will be the creative force behind the Agentforce Sales narratives delivered on our biggest stages, including Dreamforce, Salesforce World Tours, key third-party events, and internal company-wide gatherings. This requires a rare combination of narrative instincts, creative boldness, and the discipline to bring it all to life under the brightest lights.

Key Responsibilities

  • Portfolio Narrative & Storytelling: Own the narrative arc for the entire Agentforce Sales portfolio — not just messaging frameworks, but the story we tell the market about who we are, why it matters, and why now. Develop, evolve, and pressure-test that narrative against real customer reality, competitive dynamics, and business strategy.

  • Keynote & Executive Presentation Leadership: Lead end-to-end development of high-impact keynotes for Dreamforce, World Tours, and flagship events, including narrative structure, slide creation, scripting, demo integration, and speaker coaching. You don’t just write the story; you help others own it and deliver it with conviction on the biggest stages.

  • Customer Advocacy: Build a customer storytelling engine — identifying champions, shaping their stories, and activating them across events, case studies, social, and media. Partner with Sales and Customer Success to turn customer wins into market-moving moments that others want to be part of.

  • Market Influence & Third-Party Advocacy: Cultivate relationships with analysts, influencers, and industry voices to carry the Agentforce Sales narrative beyond owned channels. Develop the programs, content, and proof points that give external voices a story worth telling — and the credibility to tell it.

  • Narrative Enablement: Serve as the storytelling lead across the broader PMM team — setting the standard, facilitating big idea development, and enabling colleagues to activate the narrative consistently across every channel and medium.

  • Content & Asset Development: Articulate the Agentforce Sales value proposition across a range of assets, including core pitch decks, messaging and positioning frameworks, customer success stories, event content, and enablement materials to ensure the narrative stays coherent from the keynote stage to the sales floor.

  • Messaging Activation: Partner closely with Sales Cloud leadership, Product Management, and fellow Product Marketers to translate product capabilities into customer benefits and market-facing stories aligned to business strategy.

  • Product Launch & GTM Support: Collaborate with product marketing teams on major product launches, ensuring the portfolio narrative is integrated seamlessly into go-to-market strategies.

  • Market Intelligence: Stay close to market trends, competitive landscapes, and customer insights to continuously sharpen messaging and identify new opportunities for differentiation.

  • Project Management: Manage complex, multi-stakeholder projects with the discipline to deliver high-quality output on deadline - without letting process become the story.

Required Skills & Experience

  • 8+ years of experience in product marketing or a related field, with a strong focus on enterprise software or SaaS products, preferably within CRM, revenue, and sales technology.

  • A master storyteller - proven ability to develop narratives that simplify complexity, move audiences, and hold up under scrutiny from customers, analysts, and executives alike.

  • Demonstrated ability to build a narrative and then transfer ownership of it by coaching executives, colleagues, customers, and partners to deliver it with conviction, not just recite it.

  • Extensive experience crafting and delivering high-stakes executive presentations, including narrative structure, scripting, slide-building, and speaker preparation for major public stages.

  • Track record of building customer advocacy: identifying champions, shaping their stories, and activating them in ways that shift market perception.

  • Experience cultivating relationships with analysts, influencers, and industry voices to extend a brand narrative through third-party channels.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex ideas feel inevitable and simple.

  • Proven track record of launching products and driving go-to-market strategies in close partnership with cross-functional teams.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to hold many threads at once without losing sight of the story.

  • Strategic thinker with a creative edge and genuine passion for the craft of storytelling.

  • Bachelor's degree required; MBA a plus.

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

raw.description:
Leidos, a leading defense, intelligence, and technology company, is seeking motivated and detail-oriented students for our Summer 2027 Internship Program (Starts May 2027). As a Regulatory Document Intern, you will join our Digital Sector supporting the Program Operations team on the Global Solutions Management – Operations II (GSM-O II) contract. This position is 100% remote (with a primary focus on U.S. Eastern and Central time zones), offering a unique opportunity to gain exposure to real-world program operations, government contracting processes, and cross-functional collaboration within a massive, $600M+ global defense organization.

Your Opportunity:

Are you looking to understand how massive government defense contracts are actually managed and sustained? As an intern on the Process Operations team, you will assist in managing the critical documentation and contract deliverables (CDRLs) that keep the GSM-O II contract compliant and moving forward. This role offers direct insight into government contracting and the operational support functions essential to a major defense contractor.

What You’ll Do (Potential Projects & Learning Opportunities):

  • Assist with the tracking, organizing, and management of Contract Data Requirements List (CDRL) deliverables across GSM-O II and other division programs.
  • Support the scheduling and coordination of critical document submissions to government customers.
  • Gain hands-on experience helping to prepare, review, and format official reports and deliverables for submission.
  • Participate in team meetings, assisting with the documentation and tracking of action items.
  • Coordinate with technical and operational team members to ensure delivery timelines and compliance requirements are understood.
  • Maintain highly organized records of all documentation and delivery statuses.
  • Support ongoing process improvement efforts, AI integration, and documentation standardization initiatives.

What You’ll Bring (Required):

  • Citizenship & Clearance: Must be a U.S. citizen. A security clearance is not required to start. However, selected candidates must be eligible to obtain a DoD Secret security clearance post-onboarding, which Leidos will sponsor if necessary.
  • Education: Currently pursuing a degree (Business, English, Communications, Information Systems, or a related field is preferred).
  • Professional Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills, with exceptional attention to detail and organizational capabilities.
  • Tools: Basic proficiency in the Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
  • Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a virtual team environment, manage multiple tasks, and coordinate across different functional groups.
  • Location: This internship is 100% remote. Candidates must be based in the United States and have a reliable internet connection to support remote work and video conferencing capabilities.

What We Want (Desired):

  • A strong interest in government contracting, technical writing, or program operations.
  • Experience with academic or internship-based report writing, editing, or documentation.
  • Familiarity with project coordination, administrative support tasks, or SharePoint.
  • Familiarity with IT and software terminology.
  • Strong time management and organizational skills to meet strict delivery deadlines.

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

White Pine Innovations is part of the Seneca Nation Group (SNG) portfolio of companies. Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

White Pine Innovations is seeking a Management Analyst to support the Defense Security Cooperation University (DSCU) Brigadier General Charles Young Research, Analysis, and Lessons Learned Institute (DSCA Young Institute) (CY-RALLI): Contractor shall provide qualified personnel to support the research-based mission and training programs of the Brigadier General Charles Young Research, Analysis, and Lessons Learned Institute (CY-RALLI). The core focus of this support shall be research, analysis, learning practices, and the development of and knowledge products for the Security Cooperation (SC) workforce. The successful candidate will be highly knowledgeable in customer experience, stakeholder engagement, and program/financial management as well as possess excellent interpersonal and communications skills. Significant experience with and knowledge of the Defense Security Cooperation Agency is highly preferred.

Roles and Responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Conduct research and providing analytical support to DSCU faculty and staff.
  • Lead and establish priorities for the vetting of content, product development, reviews, dissemination strategy, and coordination of stakeholders.
  • Research findings and literature reviews from existing research materials, catalogs, and other diverse source findings.
  • Actionable Analysis of the collected research and findings to identify the most relevant security cooperation information and translate findings into actionable indicators and evidenced based recommendations for improving outcomes. Identify information gaps and usability issues. Translate finding into practical products.
  • Synthesize findings to identify the most relevant security cooperation information and translate into indicators to present in the Job Aids.
  • Design and develop evidenced based Job Aids to include depictions of research findings to clearly present complex data. The anticipated quantity to Job Aids annually is 15-20 final products utilizing a cumulative total consisting of 35-45 verified data sources.
  • Prepare, update, and manage Quarterly Knowledge Products Plan with final review of all products before dissemination.
  • Coordinate guest speakers, panels, briefings and consultations with guidance from DSCU.

Basic Requirements:

  • Master’s degree in a related research field.
  • 10+ years of experience in or supporting the US government.
  • Must be a US Citizen with an active Secret Clearance or ability to obtain a favorable suitability adjudication, based on a Tier 3 background investigation.
  • Research, storyboard, and prepare visual material for executive-level and academic presentations
  • Establishes metrics and feedback loops to monitor how products contribute to workforce readiness and evidence-based decision-making, driving continuous improvement.
  • Conduct research and analysis of SC workforce needs, gaps, lessons learned, and best practices to inform knowledge product development and curriculum planning across a 16,000-strong global SC workforce.
  • Builds relationships with subject matter experts and practitioners to refine materials and ensure accuracy, usability, and relevance to the SC workforce.
  • Strong client-facing communication and stakeholder engagement skills, including the ability to synchronize research and training priorities with government supervisors, functional leads, senior leadership, and partner organizations.
  • Excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Microsoft Office 365 (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Teams, SharePoint) and AI proficiency.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Certification in Training Management
  • Substantial experience within the Security Cooperation environment and requisite knowledge of management operations and stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of Security Cooperation policies and regulations.
  • Experience supporting DSCU, DSCA, or comparable defense security cooperation training, research, education, and institutional capacity-building
  • Experience using process improvement, business process re-engineering, or automation approaches to improve research program performance.

About Us

Every moment of every day, people all over the world rely on the infrastructure work provided by Quanta Services and Quanta Government Solutions (QGS). With its highly skilled and innovative workforce, Quanta is the largest specialty contractor in North America that powers modern life. Find your future with us by being a part of something bigger – leading the energy transition in building a better world for generations to come.

Imagine what you could do here. We encourage and inspire our people to embrace opportunities within our corporate office and 200 operating companies providing solutions for the utility, renewable energy, electric power, industrial, communications and government industries worldwide.

Quanta’s culture is about creating an environment where all employees can be themselves, are valued, and have an equal opportunity to succeed. When you join our team, you join a dynamic culture in which career development is encouraged, excellence is rewarded, and diversity is valued.

About this Role

COMPANY: Quanta Government Solutions, LLC

JOB TITLE: Proposal Coordinator

DEPARTMENT: Preconstruction Operations

LOCATION: Remote

REPORTS TO: Proposal Manager

CLASSIFICATION: Non-Exempt

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The Proposal Coordinator supports the development and delivery of compliant, compelling, and timely proposals for federal construction and infrastructure projects. This role will work closely with proposal managers and proposal specialists, subject matter experts, and technical teams to ensure high-quality submissions that align with federal acquisition regulations and client expectations.

What You'll Do

  • Coordinate the end-to-end proposal development process for federal solicitations, including response to Requests for Information (RFIs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and Requests for Qualifications (RFQs).
  • Assist with analyzing solicitation documents and developing proposal outlines and compliance matrices.
  • Collaborate with internal and external teams as needed (technical writers, estimators, and subject matter experts) to gather and organize proposal content.
  • Format, edit, and proofread proposal documents to ensure consistency, clarity, and compliance.
  • Maintain proposal templates, resumes, project descriptions, and past performance data.
  • Support color team reviews and incorporate feedback to improve proposal quality.
  • Work flexible hours to meet critical deadlines.
  • Apply knowledge of FAR/DFARS and federal procurement processes to ensure compliance.
  • Obtain and maintain past performance of company and affiliates.

What You'll Bring

Required Education, Certification and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Business, English, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in proposal coordination and development.

Preferred Education, Certification and Experience

  • SMPS certification or similar credentials are a plus.

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • None

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Travels: Yes (up to 10%)

raw.description:
Job Title: Junior Sales Development Representative

Reports to: Managing Director DVT UK

ROLE OVERVIEW

The Junior Sales Development Representative (SDR) plays a crucial role in the sales process by identifying and qualifying potential leads for the sales team. This position involves proactive outreach, lead generation, and building initial relationships with prospects. The primary goal is to create a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities for the sales team to pursue.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Lead Generation:

  • Conduct targeted research to identify potential customers and decision-makers.
  • Use various channels (email, phone calls, social media) to generate and qualify leads.
  • Collaborate with marketing to leverage inbound leads and enhance lead generation efforts.

Outreach and Engagement:

  • Initiate contact with prospects through personalised and effective communication.
  • Clearly articulate the value proposition of the company's products or services.
  • Engage in initial conversations to understand prospect needs and qualify their interest.

Qualification:

  • Assess the fit of leads based on predefined criteria.
  • Collaborate with sales to understand ideal customer profiles and refine qualification parameters.
  • Disqualify leads that do not meet the criteria to ensure a focused sales effort.

Pipeline Management:

  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records of all prospect interactions in the CRM system.
  • Regularly update the sales team on the status of leads and opportunities.
  • Prioritize and manage a high volume of leads to ensure a steady flow through the sales funnel.

Collaboration with Sales Team:

  • Work closely with Account Executives and Sales Managers to understand sales strategies and priorities.
  • Provide valuable insights from prospect interactions to refine messaging and targeting.

Continuous Learning:

  • Stay informed about industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities.
  • Attend training sessions and actively seek opportunities for professional development.

Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
  • Excellent interpersonal and relationship-building abilities.
  • Results-driven with a focus on meeting and exceeding targets.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems and sales tools.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
  • Resilience and persistence in the face of rejection.
  • Basic understanding of the company's products/services and industry.

raw.description:
Job Description

We’re looking for a motivated communications professional to join the Global Media and Strategy Communications team to help drive key initiatives related to business strategy, financial communications and overall brand reputation. Under the direction of the senior manager of Global Media and Strategy, the ideal candidate will become a subject matter expert and develop compelling narratives that support the business area’s strategy and key financial communications. This role will develop strategic content, coordinate integrated communications initiatives, and deliver tactics through a variety of both internal and external communications channels including Tier-1 media engagements. This position serves as a trusted communications partner across the Corporate Communications organization, collaborating closely with CEO/COO Communications, Investor Relations, Finance, Government Affairs, Legal, Global Business Development & Strategy, and business area communications teams. The ideal candidate combines exceptional writing ability with strong business acumen, project management discipline, and intellectual curiosity. This individual is comfortable synthesizing complex business, financial, geopolitical, and national security issues into compelling communications that resonate with diverse audiences.

Key Responsibilities

Support Enterprise Strategy Narratives

  • Develop messaging, presentations, briefing materials, talking points, and written content that clearly communicate the larger enterprise strategy and corporate priorities.
  • Translate complex business, financial, technology, and policy topics into compelling talking points tailored for external and internal stakeholders.
  • Drive consistency of messaging across executive communications, enterprise campaigns and media relations.
  • Provide recommendations for proactive media pitching related to long-term strategic priorities.

Support Financial Communications

  • Assist in the development and coordination of communications supporting quarterly earnings, investor messaging, the annual report, and other financial milestones.
  • Develop content that drives key financial narratives for both internal and external audiences to drive business success.
  • Draft supporting communications materials, including executive talking points, Q&A documents, messaging frameworks, fact sheets, and internal communications.

Executive Communications & Thought Leadership

  • Support preparation for media interviews, conferences, customer engagements, and policy forums.
  • Partner to drive significant growth pillar focus areas while partnering with counterparts across the business.
  • Research emerging industry, defense, geopolitical, technology, and policy developments to strengthen executive positioning.

Communications Planning and Operations

  • Manage timelines, deliverables, approvals, editorial planning documents, and cross-functional coordination across multiple concurrent initiatives ensuring that communications activities remain aligned with business priorities.
  • Monitor industry trends, competitor communications, investor sentiment, public policy developments and media narratives.
  • Produce executive-ready summaries, strategic insights, and communications recommendations.
  • Support measurement of communications effectiveness through media analysis, message penetration, and executive engagement metrics.
  • Serve as a liaison for enterprise messaging resources and as a partner to representatives across the business.

Basic Qualifications

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited college, or equivalent experience/combined education, with 3+ years of professional experience.
  • Experience in corporate communications, public affairs, executive communications, investor relations support, journalism, public policy communications, or related field.
  • Demonstrated experience writing for executive audiences.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities.
  • Ability to work independently under general direction while collaborating effectively across teams.
  • Ability to travel as required.

Desired Skills

Desired Skills & Experience

  • Experience supporting communications within a publicly traded company, government organization, aerospace and defense company, or strategic communications consulting firm.
  • Familiarity with financial communications, including earnings announcements, annual reporting, investor messaging, or corporate disclosures.
  • Strong research and analytical capabilities with the ability to synthesize complex information quickly.
  • Experience and/or desire to learn general web development for resource management.
  • Excellent executive writing skills, including speeches, talking points, presentations, briefing documents, and messaging frameworks.
  • Understanding of media relations, reputation management, and executive positioning.
  • Knowledge of national security, defense, aerospace, technology, or geopolitical issues.
  • Strong organizational and project management skills with exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency using Microsoft Office, collaboration tools, and communications planning platforms.

Who You Are

  • An intellectually curious communications professional who enjoys understanding complex business issues.
  • A strong writer capable of translating technical, financial, and strategic topics into compelling stories.
  • Compelled to do research and compare multiple sources to develop a robust communications product.
  • A self-starter who works independently while knowing when to seek guidance.
  • Eager to learn from senior leaders while taking ownership of increasingly strategic work.

Success in This Role Looks Like

  • Enterprise messaging is consistently executed across communications products with clarity, accuracy, and alignment.
  • Senior leaders and cross-functional partners view this communicator as a trusted, responsive communications resource.
  • Strategic research and analysis inform communications planning and improve message effectiveness.
  • Multiple high-priority initiatives are managed simultaneously with strong attention to detail and disciplined execution.
  • This communicator demonstrates increasing ownership of enterprise communications initiatives and is prepared to assume broader strategic responsibilities over time.

Pay Information

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 1): $90600.00 - $168200.00

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 3): $72500.00 - $134600.00

  • Full-time salary range (GEOZONE 4): $65200.00 - $121200.00
    • Includes metropolitan areas such as Camden, AR; Lexington, KY; Ocala, FL; Lufkin, TX; etc.

At Lockheed Martin, we know mission success starts with taking care of our people. Our Total Rewards program is designed to attract top talent, support your well-being, and help you grow—both professionally and personally.

The salary range for this position is as listed on the requisition. Please note that the salary information listed is a general guideline only.
Lockheed Martin considers factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience, education/ training, key skills as well as market(work location) and business considerations when extending an offer.

Benefits offered: Medical, Dental, Vision, Flexible work arrangements and schedules (e.g., 4x10), 401(k) match, Paid time off, Holidays, Parental Leave, EAP, Flexible Spending Accounts, Education Assistance, Life Insurance, Short-Term Disability, and Long-Term Disability.

raw.description:
Hi, we’re CompanyCam.

We’re a simple-to-use photo documentation and productivity app for contractors of all commercial and home services industries. Packed with intuitive functionality, CompanyCam facilitates unparalleled communication and accountability across a contractor’s entire business. We’re committed to providing a consumer-grade, game-changing experience that helps our users build trust within their company and with their customers.

But don’t let that corporate description fool you—the people behind our buttoned-up product are laid-back (but hardworking), genuine, and kickass, and you could be one of them!

The Role

CompanyCam is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead a small team of PMs focused on CompanyCam’s in-app communication and project organization tools. This is a player-coach role: you'll be hands-on with discovery, roadmap prioritization, and delivery while also coaching your direct reports and building shared strategy across your group. Your team is working on one of CompanyCam's most active product areas right now - an in-platform communications hub that helps field crews coordinate with each other and keep homeowners informed on job progress. If you thrive at the intersection of execution and team leadership, and you're energized by building something that makes real work easier for the people doing it, we’d love to talk to you.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and mentor a team of 2 Product Managers, fostering their growth while maintaining hands-on involvement in key initiatives
  • Lead discovery efforts to ensure we consistently deliver value for our biggest customers
  • Build and maintain relationships across engineering, data, design, finance, and marketing teams, proactively sharing insights and achieving cross-functional alignment

The Impact You'll Have

At CompanyCam, your work makes a real impact. Whether you're writing code, supporting customers, or designing experiences, your contributions directly shape the product we deliver and the people we serve. We're building something that helps real people solve real problems—and we believe that kind of work is best done by a team that reflects the world around us. In this role, you’ll drive impact by:

  • Drive growth through comprehensive, end-to-end initiatives that span insight generation, experimental design, and cross-functional execution
  • Launch new features, build new mobile and web experiences, craft product briefs, and define success metrics to ensure we know if we’ve hit the mark with our efforts

What You'll Bring

  • You bring 7+ years of product experience, with at least 2 years of team leadership or mentorship experience
  • You have a proven track record of driving business impact through data-driven experimentation, breaking down complex problems with curiosity and analytical rigor
  • You're a strategic thinker who looks around corners, thinking several steps ahead while maintaining an ability to communicate complex ideas clearly
  • You have strong cross-functional collaboration skills, understanding that impact comes from empowering others rather than doing everything yourself
  • You can balance hands-on execution with team leadership, knowing when to dive deep and when to delegate
  • Your background reflects a blend of analytical depth and product vision – whether you were a data analyst who wanted to build products or a product person with a passion for data
  • You take an AI-forward approach to work, using it as a force multiplier to help you tackle harder problems
  • A continuous growth-mindset, with a focus on learning, embracing challenges, and continuously improving.
  • A knack for creativity and innovation, bringing fresh ideas to the table and solving complex problems.

Bonus Points

  • You're familiar with and have used the set of practices outlined in Continuous Discovery Habits by Teresa Torres
  • You've spent some portion of your career developing solutions for in-platform communications
  • Experience in the construction or contractor industry

About The Product Team

We have four principles:

  1. Holistic thinking: We know that nothing exists in a silo at a team, discipline, or feature level
  2. Proactive collaboration: We build context together and encourage synchronous, streamlined work from our colleagues and diversity in problem-solving
  3. Data-driven decision-making: We use first principles and are skeptical so we can get to the right answer to deliver value quickly
  4. Disciplined prioritization: We substantiate the size of the opportunity we're pursuing, ensuring it connects back to the squad’s outcomes and the business’s strategy

Benefits & Compensation

This is a salaried position at CompanyCam. Our starting salary range is $190,000-$210,000 per year and is based on experience. We also offer meaningful equity and other benefits.

CompanyCam is an equal-opportunity employer committed to respect, inclusion, and growth. We work hard, take responsibility, and support each other. Great ideas come from all backgrounds, and we carefully consider every applicant without regard to personal characteristics or traits. Even if your work experience doesn’t align perfectly, we encourage you to apply. What really matters to us is your potential, your passion, and your commitment to learning, innovation, and contributing meaningfully to our team.

For any accommodations or technical issues related to the online application or interview process, please email and we’ll respond promptly. Please do not include any medical or health information in your message.

Note: Resumes sent to this email will not be reviewed or responded to. To be considered for a position, you must apply directly through our careers page.

raw.excerpt: Sobre el rolBuscamos un Backend Engineer hands-on responsable de diseñar, construir y operar servicios backend en producción dentro de un entorno AWS corporativo.
raw.description:
Sobre el rol

Buscamos un Backend Engineer hands-on responsable de diseñar, construir y operar servicios backend en producción dentro de un entorno AWS corporativo. El eje del rol es el desarrollo backend sólido: APIs bien estructuradas, patrones de diseño aplicados, código seguro y auditable.

El candidato no será responsable del desarrollo frontend, pero sí debe asegurar que los servicios que construya estén correctamente diseñados para ser consumidos por aplicaciones en React/Next: estructuras de respuesta claras, validaciones, contratos de integración y manejo de errores.

La empresa opera bajo lineamientos corporativos estrictos: casa matriz audita el código, existen herramientas automáticas de verificación de calidad y seguridad antes de cada promoción entre ambientes. Se espera que el candidato llegue con buenas prácticas ya internalizadas no como algo a aprender en el trabajo.

Requirements


— Perfil profesional y soft skills —

PERFIL PROFESIONAL

Buscamos a alguien que:

  • Ha tenido responsabilidad directa sobre lo que construye
  • Puede explicar con claridad qué desarrolló, cómo funciona y por qué se diseñó así
  • Ha trabajado en contextos reales (producción, incidentes, presión, ambigüedad)
  • Puede tomar decisiones y avanzar sin depender constantemente de otros
  • Se comunica de forma clara, directa y estructurada

En entrevista, esperamos ver:

  • Explicaciones concretas, no teóricas
  • Forma de pensar estructurada
  • Capacidad de proponer soluciones reales


    — Perfil técnico — MAPA DE SKILLS
  • Indispensable (sin esto no avanza)
    • Backend hands-on en producción
    • APIs REST + seguridad
    • AWS aplicado en producción
    • Patrones de diseño
    • Código limpio y mantenible
    • IaC: conocimiento funcional (entender cómo funciona y cómo impacta el despliegue)
  • Flexible (puede compensar con potencial claro)
    • React / Next (nivel integración, no desarrollo profundo)
    • IaC: desarrollo directo (escribir desde cero)
    • Servicios avanzados de AWS
    • Experiencia en entornos altamente regulados
  • Nice to have
    • Certificación AWS
    • Experiencia en sector financiero
    • Experiencia en entornos corporativos auditados
    • Conocimiento de CI/CD (no ownership completo)


Primer Frente: — BACKEND—

No se requiere que hayas diseñado arquitecturas de empresa completas, pero sí que puedas construir componentes de forma autónoma, tomar decisiones técnicas fundamentadas y entender el impacto de tu código en el sistema completo. No se busca un arquitecto que delega, se busca alguien que ejecuta con criterio.

(Hands-on real)

  • Experiencia desarrollando APIs en producción (Node, Python, C#, Java)
  • Diseño de APIs REST (endpoints, validaciones, manejo de errores)
  • Implementación de autenticación/autorización (JWT, OAuth2 o similar)
  • Manejo de base de datos (SQL y/o NoSQL)
  • Experiencia real ejecutando (no solo diseñando o liderando)

Stack backend

  • C# (.Net) o Node.js o Python como lenguaje principal. No importa cuál, lo que importa es la profundidad.
  • Desarrollo de APIs REST: diseño de recursos, versionamiento, autenticación (JWT, OAuth2), autorización por roles.
  • Manejo de bases de datos relacionales (SQL) e idealmente alguna NoSQL. Queries optimizadas, transacciones, índices.
  • Manejo de errores robusto: respuestas consistentes, logging estructurado, trazabilidad.
  • Pruebas unitarias e integración: no solo saber que existen también saber escribirlas y mantenerlas.

Esperamos identificar en ti:

  • Facilidad para hablar de tus APIs con propiedad de producto: conoces el input, el output, los casos de error, quién lo consume y por qué se diseñó así.
  • Claridad para explicar paso a paso cómo construiste o modificarías un servicio real: desde la definición del endpoint hasta su despliegue en producción.
  • Agilidad cuando se te presenta un escenario técnico: daR una solución concreta sin evadir o desviar el caso.
  • Capacidad para reconoces trade-offs: saber cuándo usar una Lambda vs un contenedor, una BD relacional vs una NoSQL, y poder justificarlo.
  • Transparencia para compartir cuándo has tenido incidentes en producción y poder describir cómo los identificaste, atendiste y previenes.

Buenas prácticas — 'CÓDIGO LIMPIO'

Este punto es crítico. El código es evaluado automáticamente en cada promoción entre ambientes, por lo que es importante contar con buenas prácticas bien consolidadas desde el inicio.

Patrones de diseño — deberás conocer y saber aplicar al menos uno

  • Clean Architecture (también llamada Arquitectura Limpia): separación de capas, dependencias apuntando hacia adentro, dominio independiente de infraestructura.
  • Arquitectura en Capas (Layered / N-tier): presentación, negocio, datos — claramente separados.
  • Arquitectura de Cebolla (Onion Architecture): núcleo de dominio rodeado por capas concéntricas de adaptadores.

Clean code — lo que esperamos ver en tu forma de trabajar
Se espera que puedas explicar cómo estructuras tu código, cómo separas responsabilidades y cómo manejas errores en servicios reales, con ejemplos claros de lo que has construido.

  • Separación clara de responsabilidades: cada clase, función o módulo cumple un propósito específico.
  • Uso de nombres descriptivos que hagan el código fácil de entender sin necesidad de explicaciones adicionales.
  • Lógica de negocio ubicada en las capas correctas (servicios o dominio), no en controladores.
  • Código limpio y mantenible, evitando redundancias o elementos innecesarios.
  • Manejo explícito de errores, con control y trazabilidad adecuados.

Seguridad en código — requerida, no opcional

  • Validación de inputs en backend (no confiar en el frontend para validar).
  • Protección de endpoints: autenticación + autorización correctamente implementada.
  • No hardcodear credenciales, API keys ni secrets en el código — uso de variables de entorno o servicios como AWS Secrets Manager.
  • Conocimiento básico de OWASP Top 10: SQL injection, XSS, broken auth, etc.
  • Logging sin exponer datos sensibles (PII, tokens, passwords).


Segundo Frente: — CLOUD AWS —

AWS es un componente clave del rol.

Se espera experiencia real en producción y entendimiento de cómo el backend vive dentro de un entorno cloud, pero el enfoque principal sigue siendo backend.

Se espera capacidad de explicar cómo ha desplegado servicios, cómo se conectan entre sí y cómo su código impacta el entorno.

Importante que el candidato:

  • Haya trabajado con AWS en producción (no solo teoría)
  • Entienda cómo se despliegan servicios y se promueve código entre ambientes
  • Comprenda cómo su código impacta seguridad, despliegue y operación

Servicios con los que se espera experiencia práctica

  • Lambda: creación, configuración de triggers, conexión con otros servicios, manejo de timeouts y errores.
  • API Gateway: creación de APIs, integración con Lambda, manejo de stages y autorizadores.
  • S3: gestión de objetos, permisos, políticas de acceso, lifecycle rules.
  • DynamoDB o RDS: operaciones CRUD, índices, conexión desde servicios backend.
  • IAM: roles, políticas, principio de menor privilegio — sabe por qué importa y cómo aplicarlo.


    Infraestructura como Código (IaC) — conocimiento funcional obligatorio:
  • Entiende qué es y para qué sirve: no se crean recursos manualmente en consola.
  • Puede leer y entender una plantilla de CloudFormation o un módulo de CDK/Terraform aunque no sea su especialidad.
  • Sabe cómo se declara una Lambda, un API Gateway o un rol IAM en código.
  • Entiende el ciclo: escribir IaC → plan/preview → deploy controlado.


    Seguridad en nube — nivel esperado
    • Entiende buenas prácticas básicas de seguridad al trabajar en AWS
    • Sabe que el acceso entre servicios debe manejarse mediante roles (no credenciales hardcodeadas)
    • Tiene noción de cómo se protegen APIs expuestas
    • Conoce prácticas básicas para manejo seguro de secretos
  • No se requiere especialización en seguridad cloud, pero sí criterio suficiente para desarrollar sin comprometer el entorno.


    Tercer frente: — REACT / NEXT.JS —

    El candidato no desarrollará frontend. Pero sí construirá el backend que lo alimenta. Debe entender suficiente para garantizar que sus servicios funcionen correctamente en integración.

    -Cómo el frontend consume una API- Entiendes qué estructura de respuesta espera, qué headers necesitas, cómo manejar errores HTTP
    -fetch / axios o equivalente:     Sabe cómo se hace una llamada desde frontend — puede diseñar su API pensando en quien la llama.
    -Manejo de estado básico:     Entiendes qué datos guarda el frontend y cuándo necesita refrescarlos desde el backend.
    -Qué es un hook (nivel conceptual): Sabes que el frontend maneja efectos asíncronos
    -Validación de formularios:     Entiendes qué valida el frontend vs qué debe validar el backend (y por qué el backend siempre debe validar).
    -Protección de endpoints consumidos por frontend:     Sabes implementar autenticación/autorización pensando en un cliente React.

Benefits

📍 En caso de requerir modalidad híbrida o presencial, serás informado desde la primera sesión.

🛡️ Seguro de vida (aplica para México).

​​CALSTART is seeking to fill a Project Manager to join our School Bus Team and support the administration of the Zero Emission School Bus and Infrastructure (ZESBI) Incentive Project—a $500 million initiative that will be implemented over the next several years.

The successful candidate will play a key role in the implementation of the ZESBI Incentive Project, supporting efforts under the School Bus Programs Initiative and Market Acceleration activities, as well as engaging with key external stakeholders; including the California Energy Commission (CEC) and the California Air Resources Board (CARB).

The Opportunity

Lesley University is seeking an adjunct faculty member to supervise an independent study for the doctoral program during the Fall 2026 Term I.

Independent Study Title: Practitioner Review: Organizational Knowledge

Course Description

This course explores institutional and cultural knowledge stewardship through the lens of survivance. Students examine mechanisms for protecting and sustaining collective knowledge, with particular attention to how communities and organizations maintain cultural continuity across generations while navigating change, disruption, displacement, and coloniality. Rather than treating knowledge as a resource to be managed, the course approaches knowledge as a living relationship requiring reciprocity, accountability, and care.

The course models the practices it examines through participatory inquiry, story exchange, collaborative meaning-making, and the co-creation of resources designed to support knowledge stewardship at organizational, institutional, or tribal levels.

Qualities and Capabilities

The independent study will be conducted in accordance with university guidelines for graduate independent studies. A successful candidate will have:

  • A PhD or terminal degree in Education, Literacy, or a closely related field (required)

  • Strong supervisory, teaching, and mentorship skills

Why Lesley

Located in the heart of Cambridge, Massachusetts, Lesley University is highly regarded for its graduate and undergraduate programs in the human arts of education, the arts, and applied social sciences. Lesley fosters a highly creative environment in which innovative ideas thrive, theory is integrated with practice and its 6,400 students and 90,000 alumni are empowered to improve and enrich communities.

Lesley is committed to the ongoing pursuit of strategic diversity initiatives that help to position diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental to institutional and academic excellence at Lesley. In doing so, Lesley strives for a campus culture and community that fosters a true sense of belonging for all, provides opportunity for everyone to participate equally and fully in the Lesley experience, and helps to develop each individual's capacity to confidently and competently engage within and across difference. Given an evolving national context and the rapid change in the demographic profile of our country, the University has made a significant commitment to addressing and enhancing its campus climate and diversity capabilities as an institution.

Expressing Interest

A letter of interest, CV/resume, and a statement addressing past and/or potential contributions to diversity, equity, and inclusion through teaching, professional activity, and/or service must be included for full consideration.

At Lesley University we strive for a supportive and equitable environment where people -- regardless of race, ethnicity, color, sex, physical ability, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, neurodiversity, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, veteran or military status, membership in uniformed services, and all other categories protected by applicable state and federal laws -- can participate equally and fully as their true selves in all aspects of university life. Accordingly, the University prohibits discrimination based on these protected categories in any education program or activity that it operates, including in admission and in employment. We are committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion throughout the fabric of our institution. Individuals may submit concerns or questions related to discrimination to the University's Director of Equal Opportunity. Please visit the Office of Equal Opportunity's webpage for the University's entire notice of nondiscrimination and for additional information.

You are a senior-level engineer with experience across AWS, Azure, and/or GCP environments who can architect scalable solutions, improve operational efficiency through automation, and collaborate across infrastructure, security, development, and platform engineering teams.

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Cloud Network Engineer to design, implement, automate, and support enterprise-scale cloud and hybrid network infrastructure environments. This role combines deep networking expertise with modern cloud engineering, automation, Kubernetes, and infrastructure-as-code capabilities.

This position requires strong technical leadership, hands-on engineering capability, and the ability to operate effectively in complex multi-cloud enterprise environments.

Other responsibilities include:

Cloud & Network Architecture

  • Design and support secure, scalable cloud networking solutions across AWS, Azure, and GCP
  • Engineer hybrid cloud connectivity solutions including VPN, Direct Connect, ExpressRoute, and cloud routing architectures
  • Implement and maintain enterprise DNS, load balancing, segmentation, and traffic management solutions

Infrastructure Automation & DevOps

This Test Engineering (TE) opportunity on the U.S. Navy’s Service Management, Integration, and Transport (SMIT) will allow participation on a high-visibility DoD program that provides engineering support to the Navy Marine Corps Intranet (NMCI), the largest information technology (IT) network in the world.
